posts.title: Kebbi APC reinstates suspended state chairman, Kana-Zuru
posts.excerpt: The All Progressives Congress, APC, in Kebbi State has revoked the suspension of its State Chairman, Alhaji Abubakar Kana-Zuru, and reinstated him with immediate effect. The Public Relations Officer,
posts.content:
The All Progressives Congress, APC, in Kebbi State has revoked the suspension of its State Chairman, Alhaji Abubakar Kana-Zuru, and reinstated him with immediate effect.

The Public Relations Officer, PRO, of the party in the state, Alhaji Isah Assalafi, disclosed this at a press conference held at the party’s state secretariat in Birnin Kebbi on Thursday.

The News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) recalls that Kana-Zuru was suspended last June following an internal rift within the party.

Assalafi said the Kebbi State Working Committee (KSWC), at its meeting on October 1, considered the circumstances and developments surrounding the suspension and resolved to revoke it.

He recalled that the KSWC had, at its meeting on June 20, adopted Resolution No. KSWC/010/2026, suspending Kana-Zuru from office as the state chairman.

“Having considered the subsequent circumstances and developments relating to the said suspension, the State Working Committee has deemed it appropriate to revoke the same.

“Accordingly, the suspension of Alhaji Kana-Zuru from the office of State Chairman of the APC in the state, pursuant to Resolution No. KSWC/010/2026 dated June 20, is hereby revoked with immediate effect,” he revealed.

According to him, Kana-Zuru is hereby reinstated as state chairman and shall immediately resume the full functions, powers, duties and responsibilities of the office.

He added that the interim arrangement under which Alhaji Adamu Mudi-Augie had been performing the functions of acting state chairman had also been terminated with immediate effect.

Assalafi said Mudi-Augie would consequently cease to act as chairman and resume his substantive position as Deputy State Chairman.

He further said that all official records, documents, correspondence, instruments and other affairs of the office of the state chairman would be handed over to Kana-Zuru.

The PRO said the State Secretary had been directed to communicate the resolution to the appropriate organs of the party.

“Such organs include the national headquarters of the party, for information, records and necessary action in accordance with the party’s constitution and applicable directives.

“The resolution takes effect immediately upon its adoption by the KSWC at its meeting on October 1 at the APC state secretariat in Birnin Kebbi,” the PRO said.

posts.title: East-West Road: Oborevwori mobilises Julius Berger
posts.excerpt: By Egufe Yafugborhi & Ochuko Akuopha ASABA — Delta State Governor, Sheriff Oborevwori, has mobilised Julius Berger Nigeria Plc to commence emergency remedial works on the collapsed section of the East
posts.content:
By Egufe Yafugborhi & Ochuko Akuopha

ASABA — Delta State Governor, Sheriff Oborevwori, has mobilised Julius Berger Nigeria Plc to commence emergency remedial works on the collapsed section of the East-West Road at Agbarho, Ughelli North Local Government Area of the state.

The section of the major highway collapsed on Tuesday following torrential rainfall, leaving motorists and commuters plying the busy corridor stranded and facing difficulties.

Oborevwori disclosed the intervention on Thursday while addressing residents at the Cenotaph, Asaba, during the state’s celebration of Nigeria’s 66th Independence Anniversary.

The governor said: “Few days ago in Agbarho, you people witnessed a natural disaster that happened on the East-West Road. I’ve directed Julius Berger to go and see how to fix that road as soon as possible.”

The directive has since translated into action, as Julius Berger has mobilised to the affected section and commenced emergency restoration works.

The affected portion of the highway was washed out by heavy rains, disrupting the movement of vehicles and raising concerns among residents and road users over the safety and accessibility of the route.

The intervention is expected to facilitate the speedy restoration of the damaged section and ease the difficulties faced by motorists and commuters.

The East-West Road is a major transportation route linking communities and commercial centres across the Niger Delta, with its disruption affecting motorists and businesses that depend on the corridor.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/east-west-road-oborevwori-mobilises-julius-berger/

posts.title: $700bn mineral: ITUC-Africa raises alarm over US–Nigeria deal
posts.excerpt: By Victor Ahiuma-Young The African Regional Organisation of the International Trade Union Confederation, ITUC-Africa, has raised concerns over the Nigeria–United States critical minerals framework, wa
posts.content:
By Victor Ahiuma-Young

The African Regional Organisation of the International Trade Union Confederation, ITUC-Africa, has raised concerns over the Nigeria–United States critical minerals framework, warning that Nigeria must ensure its mineral wealth contributes directly to the country’s development rather than creating another form of economic dependency.
In a statement by its General Secretary, Akhator Joel Odigie, ITUC-Africa said the framework, reportedly covering exploration, mining, processing, infrastructure and technical capacity, requires greater transparency and public scrutiny. The labour organisation also cautioned against interpreting the widely reported $700 billion figure as a US investment commitment, saying it represents an estimate of Nigeria’s mineral resources.
The statement called for the publication of the full framework and enforceable safeguards covering domestic beneficiation, local content, technology transfer, decent work, taxation, public revenues, environmental protection and community benefits.
The statement reads “The African Regional Organisation of the International Trade Union Confederation (ITUC-Africa, notes the Nigeria-US critical minerals framework signed in New York in September 2026. It reportedly covers exploration, mining, processing, infrastructure and technical capacity.
“Nigeria’s stated objectives include local processing, skills, jobs and Nigerian business participation.
“Public information on the deal is scanty, with shrouds over specific projects, financing commitments, mineral volumes, pricing, offtake provisions, duration, governance or enforceable domestic beneficiation obligations. The widely reported US$700 billion is an estimate of Nigeria’s mineral resources, not a US$700 billion investment commitment by the United States.
“This is a question of domestic resource mobilisation. Africa cannot keep seeking development finance abroad while surrendering the revenues, industrial value, and productive capacity embedded in its resources.
“Nigeria cannot replace dependence on crude oil exports with dependence on exports of lithium, rare earths or other unprocessed minerals. Changing the commodity without changing the structure of extraction is not economic transformation.
“Nigeria matters. One of Africa’s biggest economies and its most populous country, it has a large, versatile workforce and an extensive consumer base that can sustain domestic industries. Its resource choices can shape continental precedents. Africa has too often surrendered resource wealth through arrangements whose implications became clear only afterwards.
“Agreements of this strategic importance warrant legislative scrutiny, public debate and institutional oversight. Nigeria’s Constitution requires National Assembly enactment for treaties to acquire domestic force of law. What prior discussion and scrutiny has taken place in the National Assembly, including the Senate, before advancement of this framework?
“ITUC-Africa calls for publication of the full framework and enforceable safeguards on domestic beneficiation, local content, technology transfer, decent work, taxation, public revenues, environmental protection and community benefit.
“ITUC-Africa has resolved to sustain its advocacy for Africa’s resources to support its inclusive and shared economic growth and development. Guided by the African Union’s Africa Mining Vision (AMV), we will relentlessly advocate for transparent, equitable resource governance, domestic value addition, and mineral revenues that finance industrialisation, decent jobs, and shared prosperity. We salute African countries working to drive value addition to their mineral wealth and refusing to bow to internal sabotage and external manipulation.”

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/700bn-mineral-ituc-africa-raises-alarm-over-us-nigeria-deal/

posts.title: Navy rescues two kidnapped victims in Akwa Ibom
posts.excerpt: By Kingsley Omonobi The Nigerian Navy has rescued two kidnapped victims and recovered several stolen outboard engines during an operation against sea robbery and kidnapping in the Ibeno area of Akwa I
posts.content:
By Kingsley Omonobi

The Nigerian Navy has rescued two kidnapped victims and recovered several stolen outboard engines during an operation against sea robbery and kidnapping in the Ibeno area of Akwa Ibom State.

The operation was conducted on September 30, 2026, following credible intelligence on suspected sea robbers and kidnappers targeting fishermen and allegedly taking away fishing boats and outboard engines.

Director of Information, Navy Captain Abiodun Folorunsho, disclosed this in a statement, saying the Nigerian Navy Ship Jubilee Maritime Quick Response Team in Ibeno swiftly mobilised to the area after receiving the intelligence.

He said the naval team encountered two boats suspected to have been operated by the criminals, but their occupants fled into adjoining creeks as the personnel launched a pursuit.

According to him, the suspects subsequently abandoned one of the boats, which contained several stolen outboard engines and the two kidnapped victims.

“The victims were immediately rescued by the naval team and escorted to safety,” he said.

Folorunsho said the recovered outboard engines had been secured for verification and further necessary action, while efforts were ongoing to locate and apprehend the fleeing suspects.

He added that the operation underscored the Nigerian Navy’s commitment to protecting lives, securing legitimate maritime activities and sustaining proactive patrols, search-and-rescue operations and intelligence-driven interventions across Nigeria’s waterways.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/navy-rescues-two-kidnapped-victims-in-akwa-ibom/

posts.title: 2027: Tinubu healthy, fit to govern again — Sowunmi
posts.excerpt: — Urges Nigerians to shun health rumours By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta ABEOKUTA — Convener of The Alternative Movement, Otunba Segun Sowunmi, has urged Nigerians to disregard rumours about President Bo
posts.content:
— Urges Nigerians to shun health rumours

By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta

ABEOKUTA — Convener of The Alternative Movement, Otunba Segun Sowunmi, has urged Nigerians to disregard rumours about President Bola Tinubu’s health, saying the President is in good health and of sound mind.

Sowunmi spoke on Thursday at a town hall meeting in Ijebu North Local Government Area of Ogun State, where he also urged Nigerians to shun hate speech and what he described as a culture of celebrating negative developments in the country.

His comments came amid renewed speculation over Tinubu’s absence from the United Nations General Assembly, UNGA, with some critics attributing it to a medical vacation and questioning his fitness to contest the 2027 presidential election.

Sowunmi dismissed the speculation as political rumours, saying similar claims had previously been made about the President.

“The President is in good health. The President is in sound mind,” he said.

The politician urged Nigerians not to allow political disagreements to degenerate into what he described as “continuous self-hate,” arguing that some people appeared more interested in negative stories than developments and investments in the country.

“You cannot indulge in continuous self-hate to the extent that all you’re looking for is bad news. The President is in good health. The President is in sound mind,” he said.

Sowunmi also criticised what he described as the tendency of some Nigerians and political opponents to focus disproportionately on negative developments.

He urged citizens to pay attention to developments capable of attracting investment and promoting economic growth.

“Never listen to the ideas of naysayers. Never listen to the ideas of people who hate themselves and only delight in mischief and bad news,” he said.

Sowunmi also criticised some opposition presidential candidates, saying they failed to acknowledge positive developments while highlighting challenges in the country.

“You will never hear them, especially those so-called presidential candidates. They will never rejoice if anything good comes to Nigeria. By the time they hear there’s a small challenge, they’ll be rejoicing,” he said.

On the 2027 voting pattern in Ogun State, Sowunmi said the state’s large voting population should translate into increased voter turnout.

He said Ogun had almost three million registered voters and should be capable of recording figures comparable with those of some other populous states.

“The total number of registered voters in Ogun State is now almost three million. There is no reason why the people of Ogun State should not produce numbers that can rival those of Kano, Katsina or Kaduna,” he said.

Sowunmi also expressed confidence that Tinubu would win Ogun State in the 2027 presidential election, while urging residents to turn out in large numbers to vote.

“The advocacy that the President is not going to win, forget about that. He is going to win here. But what I am begging them for is to make sure that they come out in huge numbers and produce the kind of numbers we need for the President,” he said.

He also reiterated his support for Ogun State Governor, Dapo Abiodun, in the forthcoming Ogun East senatorial election, urging voters in the district to take the contest seriously.

Sowunmi said the district’s proximity to the business community and the Presidency made effective representation in the Senate important to the interests of Ogun State.

posts.title: Nigeria seeks stronger ties with Hungary — Envoy
posts.excerpt: — Braimah urges focus on opportunities, cooperation By Henry Umoru ABUJA — Nigeria’s Ambassador to Hungary, Engr. Abasi Braimah, has said Nigeria is ready to deepen cooperation with Hungary, other Eur
posts.content:
— Braimah urges focus on opportunities, cooperation

By Henry Umoru

ABUJA — Nigeria’s Ambassador to Hungary, Engr. Abasi Braimah, has said Nigeria is ready to deepen cooperation with Hungary, other European partners and the wider international community in areas of mutual interest.

Braimah, in his Independence Day address in Budapest on Thursday, also called for stronger educational, cultural and people-to-people exchanges between Nigeria and Hungary.

He said Nigeria remained committed to constructive engagement with the international community, particularly as countries confront challenges relating to food security, climate change, economic development, technology and security.

According to him, cooperation among nations remains essential in addressing the challenges.

Braimah said Nigeria and Hungary had friendly relations and identified opportunities to expand cooperation in trade and investment, agriculture, education, science and technology, manufacturing, sports, culture and tourism.

He also called for closer collaboration among universities, research institutions, businesses and young people in both countries.

“We would like to see more Nigerian products reach the Hungarian and wider European markets, while encouraging Hungarian businesses to explore the opportunities available in Nigeria.

“We also look forward to stronger educational, cultural and people-to-people exchanges between our two countries,” he said.

The envoy said Nigeria’s young people had an important role to play in the country’s future, stressing the importance of quality education, skills, technology and entrepreneurship opportunities.

He said Nigeria was prepared to work with Hungary, European partners and the wider international community on issues of mutual interest.

“Nigeria is ready to work with Hungary, our European partners and the wider international community in areas of mutual interest. We bring to these partnerships not only our needs, but also our people, ideas, resources, market and capacity to contribute,” Braimah said.

Reflecting on Nigeria’s 66 years of independence, the ambassador acknowledged the challenges the country had faced but said there was also much to celebrate.

“There is still much work to be done, but there is also much to be proud of. Nigeria has the people, talent, resources and determination to build a stronger and more prosperous future,” he said.

Braimah urged Nigerians to look beyond the country’s challenges and remain focused on available opportunities.

“As we mark this 66th anniversary, let us remain proud of our country and committed to its progress. Let us also continue to strengthen the bonds between Nigeria and Hungary and create new opportunities for cooperation between our peoples,” he said.

The ambassador expressed appreciation to the Hungarian government and people for their goodwill towards Nigeria and Nigerians living, studying and working in the country.

He also commended members of the Nigerian community in Hungary for their contributions to Hungarian society and urged them to continue to uphold values of hard work, respect and responsibility.

Braimah concluded by wishing Nigeria peace, unity, stability and prosperity, while calling for continued strengthening of the friendship between Nigeria and Hungary.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/nigeria-seeks-stronger-ties-with-hungary-envoy/

posts.title: Gunmen Abduct 20 Corps Members In Imo
posts.excerpt: Gunmen have abducted 20 corps members serving under the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) along the Owerri–Onitsha Road by Umunoha community in the Mbaitoli […] The post Gunmen Abduct 20 Corps Membe
posts.content:
Gunmen have abducted 20 corps members serving under the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) along the Owerri–Onitsha Road by Umunoha community in the Mbaitoli Local Government Area of the state.

Confirming the unfortunate incident, in a telephone conversation with Channels Television, the Police Public Relations Officer of the Imo State Police Command, Henry Okoye, said the corps members were reportedly travelling in a commercial bus from Ibadan, Oyo State, to different orientation camps in the South-East and South-South states when they were intercepted by the gunmen.

He said the Commissioner of Police, Audu Bosso, visited the scene for an on-the-spot assessment, while the police and other security agencies have intensified efforts to rescue the victims unhurt and unconditionally.

Okoye added that security operatives were currently combing surrounding bushes, while a Rapid Response Team (RRT) had also been deployed to track down the kidnappers and secure the safe release of the corps members.

‎

The incident came weeks after the police said that 11 people, including an unidentified number of corps members serving under the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC), were rescued after gunmen attacked vehicles along the Aloma–Egane Expressway.

The abduction reportedly occurred at about 4:40 p.m. on Wednesday, August 26, around Ogene Zaria, near the Ogene Zaria–Onicha-Igo Junction.

Some of the rescued corps members at the police HQ in Kogi

The armed men reportedly emerged from the bush and blocked two buses travelling in opposite directions, before abducting some of the passengers while others escaped into the bush.

The victims were, however, rescued by Joint security forces comprising the police, military, Department of State Services (DSS), and other auxiliary forces on August 31.

The Director, Defence Media Operations, Major General Michael Onoja, told journalists that the corps members were rescued from Egume Forest in Ofu Local Government Area of Kogi State, after a coordinated security operation.

President Bola Tinubu has hailed the rescue, saying the well-coordinated Search and Rescue (SAR) operation carried out by a combined team of personnel from the military, the Nigerian Police Force, the Department of State Services, and local vigilantes safely rescued all the abductees, comprising eight males and 13 females, from the den of kidnappers in the forests of Ofu on Monday afternoon.

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/10/01/gunmen-abduct-20-corps-members-in-imo/

posts.title: I’ll Not Spend My Holidays Outside Nigeria As President, Obi Says
posts.excerpt: Peter Obi said his proposed administration would seek to build a Nigeria that is “secure, united and productive,” where public resources are deployed strictly for the public good. The post I’ll Not Sp
posts.content:
Presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, has pledged that he will not spend his vacation outside Nigeria if elected President.

﻿

Obi made the promise in his Independence Day address on Thursday, saying he would instead use the period to visit different states, interact with Nigerians and better understand their challenges.

He said his holidays during his four years as President would be spent in Zamfara, Borno, Kwara, Ebonyi, Edo and Ekiti states, among others.

The former Anambra State governor said the decision would allow him to continue seeing and knowing Nigeria while spending time with Nigerians, listening to them, understanding their challenges and celebrating their resilience.

“As I have always done, I will lead by example. In four years as President of this great nation, I will not spend my holidays outside Nigeria,” Obi said. “My holidays will be spent in Zamfara State; Borno State; Kwara State; Ebonyi State; Edo State; Ekiti State and other Nigerian States.

“I want to continue to see Nigeria. I want to know Nigeria. I want to spend time with Nigerians, listen to them, understand their challenges and celebrate their resilience.”

The pledge came as part of Obi’s broader message on the need for what he described as leadership centred on the welfare and productivity of Nigerians.

He said his proposed administration would make governance measurable and accountable, with a focus on the welfare and productivity of the people.

“My message today is not one of despair. It is a message of hope, determination and responsibility. I dare to proclaim with full assurance that a new Nigeria is possible.

“As President of Nigeria, I will make governance measurable, accountable and centred on the welfare and productivity of our people. Within the first year, Nigerians will begin to see the tangible impact of purposeful and effective leadership,” he added.

Obi said the country’s challenges required serious reflection and leadership that understood the conditions facing Nigerians.

He cited his recent visit to an internally displaced persons camp at Ramin Kura in Sokoto State with Senator Rabiu Kwankwaso, where he said they held consultations with people on insecurity, out-of-school children, poverty, youth unemployment, drug abuse and other challenges.

According to Obi, thousands of women and children were living in difficult conditions after being displaced from their homes, with many children lacking access to education and mothers and children having limited access to basic healthcare.

He said such Nigerians should be living in their communities, going to school, farming their land, conducting businesses and contributing to the economy rather than living as displaced persons in their own country.

Obi said his proposed administration would seek to build a Nigeria that is “secure, united and productive”, where public resources are deployed strictly for the public good.

He also said leadership should be understood as a responsibility and public office as a sacred trust.

“The Nigeria we desire will not be built by prayers alone, nor by promises alone,” the NDC candidate stated. “It will be built by leadership that understands that public office is a sacred trust, by citizens who demand accountability, and by all of us who refuse to accept failure as our destiny. It is time to build the new and productive Nigeria that is possible.”

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/10/01/ill-not-spend-my-holidays-outside-nigeria-as-president-obi-says/

posts.title: Nigerians Will See Tangible Impact Of Effective Leadership Within My One Year As President — Obi
posts.excerpt: Peter Obi said the Nigeria citizens desire will not be built by prayers or promises alone, but by leadership that understands that public office is a sacred trust. The post Nigerians Will See Tangible
posts.content:
Presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), Peter Obi, has pledged to make governance measurable, accountable and centred on the welfare and productivity of Nigerians if elected President.

﻿

Obi made the commitment in his Independence Day address on Thursday, in which he said his administration would prioritise insecurity, education, healthcare and productive enterprise.

He said Nigerians would begin to see the impact of what he described as “purposeful and effective leadership” within the first year of his administration.

“My message today is not one of despair. It is a message of hope, determination and responsibility. I dare to proclaim with full assurance that a new Nigeria is possible,” Obi said. “As President of Nigeria, I will make governance measurable, accountable and centred on the welfare and productivity of our people. Within the first year, Nigerians will begin to see the tangible impact of purposeful and effective leadership.”

The former Anambra State governor said insecurity would be confronted decisively to enable farmers to return to their farms, children to return to school and businesses to operate freely.

“We will confront insecurity decisively so that our farmers can return to their farms, our children can return to school, businesses can operate freely, and families can live without fear,” he said.

“No Nigerian should be forced to live in an IDP camp because his or her government has failed to provide security. My administration will work to ensure that Nigerians displaced by insecurity can begin to return safely and with dignity to their communities.”

Economic Shift

The NDC candidate also promised to shift Nigeria from what he described as a consumption-driven economy to a productive one focused on job creation, agriculture, manufacturing, human capital and expanded opportunities.

He said education, healthcare, security and productive enterprise would be treated as foundations of a functioning nation rather than luxuries.

Obi’s address also highlighted the conditions he said he witnessed during a recent two-day visit to Sokoto State with Senator Rabiu Kwankwaso.

According to him, their visit to the internally displaced persons camp at Ramin Kura in Sokoto metropolis exposed the difficult conditions facing thousands of displaced women and children.

“These are Nigerians who should be living in their communities, going to school, farming their land, conducting their businesses and contributing to the economy. Instead, they live as displaced persons in their own country,” he added.

Obi said the situation in Ramin Kura was representative of the hardship experienced in other parts of the country, while blaming political leaders for failing Nigerians and children.

“The political leaders have failed our country and, most importantly, we have failed our children. This must change,” he said.

According to the former governor, Nigeria’s challenges could not be attributed to a lack of resources, arguing that the country had instead failed to translate its resources into human development, productivity, security and shared prosperity.

He cited poverty, out-of-school children, insecurity, hunger, maternal and infant mortality, youth unemployment and underemployment, drug abuse and low life expectancy among the challenges confronting the country.

Obi also pledged that, if elected, he would spend his holidays in different parts of Nigeria rather than outside the country.

“As I have always done, I will lead by example. In four years as President of this great nation, I will not spend my holidays outside Nigeria,” the NDC candidate said.

“My holidays will be spent in Zamfara State; Borno State; Kwara State; Ebonyi State; Edo State; Ekiti State and other Nigerian States. I want to continue to see Nigeria. I want to know Nigeria. I want to spend time with Nigerians, listen to them, understand their challenges and celebrate their resilience.”

He said his administration would seek to build a Nigeria that is “secure, united and productive,” governed with competence, accountability and justice.

Obi also called for citizens to demand accountability, saying the country could not be built through prayers and promises alone.

He stated, “The Nigeria we desire will not be built by prayers alone, nor by promises alone. It will be built by leadership that understands that public office is a sacred trust, by citizens who demand accountability, and by all of us who refuse to accept failure as our destiny. It is time to build the new and productive Nigeria that is possible.”

posts.title: Sporting justice dismissed Rocchi and referee influence investigation
posts.excerpt: As expected, the sporting justice system has also shelved the investigation into Gianluca Rocchi and...
posts.content:
As expected, the sporting justice system has also shelved the investigation into Gianluca Rocchi and referees, confirming no direct contact with clubs including Inter.

The scandal had at first seemed to be on the same level as Calciopoli when it erupted in April, with refereeing designator Rocchi under formal investigation for sporting fraud.

Rocchi, referees and clubs cleared

AIA chief Gianluca Rocchi (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)It focused primarily on incidents during the 2024/25 season, suggesting that Rocchi had tried to influence the decisions made by VAR officials in the hub of monitors in Lissone, near Milan.

There were also intercepted wiretaps with discussions on which referees not to assign to Inter matches, because there were some officials that were not ‘liked’ by the club.

PISA, ITALY – MARCH 2: General view of the VAR monitor inside the Arena Garibaldi stadium in Pisa during the Serie A match between Pisa SC and Bologna FC 1909 at Arena Garibaldi on March 2, 2026 in Pisa, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images)The investigation for all these elements ultimately petered out, with the Milan Public Prosecutor announcing on July 15 that the case had been dismissed.

Now the sporting justice system has followed suit, finding no evidence of direct contact between clubs and Rocchi or his assistant Andrea Gervasoni.

This effectively ends the matter, unless any new evidence were to come to light, but that seems unlikely at this stage.

Source: https://football-italia.net/sporting-justice-dismiss-rocchi-investigation/

posts.title: U21 | Armenia 0-1 Italy: Cisse to the rescue after Koleosho penalty miss
posts.excerpt: Italy hit the crossbar twice in Armenia and Luca Koleosho saw his penalty saved, but...
posts.content:
Italy hit the crossbar twice in Armenia and Luca Koleosho saw his penalty saved, but Milan talent Alphadjo Cisse snatched a last-gasp winner to keep European U21 Championship qualifying hopes alive.

The Azzurrini knew their only hope of topping the group and earning direct qualification to the European Championship was to beat Armenia and then win the head-to-head with Poland.

Frosinone striker Antonio Raimondo pulled out through injury, so Francesco Camarda started despite barely getting any playing time at Milan this season.

CESENA – OCTOBER 10: Silvio Baldini head coach of Italy U21 during the UEFA Under21 EURO Qualifier betweenItaly U21 v Sweden U21 and ad hoc Arena im Ernst-Abbe-Sportfeld on October 10, 2025 in Cesena (Photo by Alessandro Sabattini/Getty Images)Armenia were dangerous early doors with a few counter-attacks and a Hakobyan effort from the edge of the area, but Seydou Fini wasted a golden opportunity on 20 minutes when nodding the Luca Koleosho cross inches wide of the near post.

His Frosinone teammate Lorenzo Palmisani made a tricky low save on Misak Hakobyan, while Cher Ndour couldn’t keep his header on target from the Niccolò Pisilli corner.

Camarda forced a save after the restart and Milan talent Alphadjo Cisse thought his curler had opened the scoring, only to see it smack against the crossbar.

CREMONA – OCTOBER 14: Luca Koleosho of Italy in action during the UEFA Euro U21 Qualification match between Italy and Armenia at Stadio Giovanni Zini on October 14, 2025 in Cremona, (Photo by Marco M. Mantovani/Getty Images)Luck was really not on Italy’s side today, as Niccolò Fortini knocked on a Mattia Liberali free kick for Pietro Comuzzo’s header again onto the frame of the goal.

The Azzurrini received a penalty for Petik Manukyan’s handling offence on an acrobatic Cisse flick, but Koleosho saw his spot-kick saved by Hayk Ghazaryan.

CESENA – OCTOBER 10: Silvio Baldini head coach of Italy U21 during the UEFA Under21 EURO Qualifier betweenItaly U21 v Sweden U21 and ad hoc Arena im Ernst-Abbe-Sportfeld on October 10, 2025 in Cesena. (Photo by Alessandro Sabattini/Getty Images)Cisse was the last to give up and after forcing a sensational save from Ghazaryan with a left-foot volley from the edge of the area, the 19-year-old snatched a last-gasp winner.

The Armenian goalkeeper made another wonderful save to deny Luigi Cherubini, and this time Cisse was ready to pounce on the rebound.

Armenia 0-1 Italy

Cisse 95 (I)

Saved penalty: Koleosho 77 (I)

Armenia U21: Ghazaryan; Tsarukyan, Manukyan, A Hakobyan, Krmzian; Askaryan, D Hakobyan (Kirakosian 61), Sargsyan (Ayvazyan 46); Harutyunyan (Davytan 61), Eloyan (Vardanyan 75), M Hakobyan (Vardanyan 75)

Italy U21: Palmisani; Favasuli (Lulli 46), Chiarodia, Comuzzo, Moruzzi (Fortini 52); Ndour, Lipani (Liberali 46), Pisilli; Fini (Cisse 46), Camarda, Koleosho (Cherubini 79)

posts.title: Mancini: ‘Italy always play to win, even against top team like France’
posts.excerpt: Roberto Mancini assures Italy ‘must always play looking for the victory’ even in tomorrow’s Nations...
posts.content:
Roberto Mancini assures Italy ‘must always play looking for the victory’ even in tomorrow’s Nations League showdown with France. ‘There will be fewer changes than in Turkiye.’

It kicks off at the Stade de France in Paris on Friday at 19.45 UK time (20.45 CEST).

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Davide Frattesi of Italy celebrates scoring his team’s second goal with teammates during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)The Nations League has been a mixed bag so far for the Azzurri, who were crushed 2-0 at home by Belgium, but then earned a 4-1 victory away to Vincenzo Montella’s Turkiye.

It therefore remains to be seen which side we’ll see in Paris against the Group A runaway leaders, who won both their games 1-0 on their travels.

Mancini wants to see Italy improvement

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Roberto Mancini, Head Coach of Italy, looks on before the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)“It will certainly be a great game against a top team, full of extraordinary players, but we always want to make a good impression and will do our best,” Mancini told Sky Sport Italia.

“When you are up against such strong teams, you never play not to win, so naturally we must always play looking for the victory. After that, anything can happen in a game situation.”

Roberto Mancini at the Italy training session in September 2026 (figc.it)Giacomo Raspadori and Nicolò Zaniolo have left the camp due to injury, while nine others were left behind to train at Coverciano.

They are Samuele Inacio, Alessandro Romano, Honest Ahanor, Nicolò Cambiaghi, Diego Coppola, Daniele Ghilardi, Eddy Kouadio, Rolando Mandragora and Massimo Pessina.

Italy training session overseen by coach Roberto Mancini in September 2026 (figc.it)“I have a few doubts, we’ll evaluate tomorrow morning to see how some have recovered after Bursa.”

When Mancini was pressed on some particular choices, such as Pio Esposito or Moise Kean upfront, he threw in a wild card.

“Or Scamacca? We’ll make fewer changes than we saw in Bursa, that’s for sure.”

Will Sandro Tonali be the playmaker again?

“Maybe,” smiled Mancini.

posts.title: Tonali ‘was sad in first weeks’ at Newcastle United after leaving Milan
posts.excerpt: Sandro Tonali ‘was sad’ for the first few weeks when he first left Milan for...
posts.content:
Sandro Tonali ‘was sad’ for the first few weeks when he first left Milan for Newcastle United, said his agent, but the Premier League and then Tottenham Hotspur ‘proved the right choice.’

The Italy midfielder grew up supporting the Rossoneri from nearby Brescia and jumped at the chance to join them when they called, going on to be part of the team that won the Serie A title.

So when the huge offer arrived for him to move to Newcastle United, the player was hesitant.

Tonali unsure about Newcastle United move

NEWCASTLE UPON TYNE, ENGLAND – FEBRUARY 28: Sandro Tonali of Newcastle United during the Premier League match between Newcastle United and Everton at St James’ Park on February 28, 2026 in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. (Photo by George Wood/Getty Images)“We made the first step because we realised that Milan were becoming different,” agent Beppe Riso told the Colpi da Maestro podcast.

“I know Milan well, and this was not giving the same sensations as that historic club. Talking to Sandro, we considered that going to the Premier League was a fascinating challenge. He had courage to go, because he was one of the most important players in the Scudetto-winning side, but he was a visionary.”

The move to England was not entirely without problems, as the representative admits it took a while to settle in Newcastle.

“It was very difficult for him, in the first few weeks he was sad, but he got a handle on things and made his mark, as always.”

NEWCASTLE UPON TYNE, ENGLAND – FEBRUARY 24: Sandro Tonali of Newcastle United celebrates scoring his team’s first goal during the UEFA Champions League 2025/26 League Knockout Play-off Second Leg match between Newcastle United FC and Qarabag FK at St James’ Park on February 24, 2026 in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images)There are reports the overall price that Newcastle United paid to Milan in the summer of 2023 was €67m plus add-ons.

That was then later dwarfed by the €108m that Tottenham Hotspur shelled out to purchase the same player three years later.

“It was a crazy move for the numbers, but also for the responsibility,” added Riso.

“When you talk to Sandro and explain your vision, you take responsibility. It was complicated during those first few weeks when I saw how sad he was, but after a while he got used to it and it proved to be the right choice.”

SYDNEY, AUSTRALIA – AUGUST 01: Italy international Sandro Tonali of Tottenham Hotspur celebrates scoring a goal during the Sydney Super Cup match between Chelsea FC and Tottenham at Accor Stadium on August 01, 2026 in Sydney, Australia. (Photo by Brendon Thorne/Getty Images)Tonali has a history of taking time to settle, as he struggled when first making the step up from Brescia to Milan too.

“He didn’t do that well the first year, but you could sense in his attitude that he was different from the other lads. When you get close to him, you recognise he is a champion and a great man.”

Source: https://football-italia.net/tonali-was-sad-in-first-weeks-newcastle-united/

posts.title: Enter Shikari to go on indefinite hiatus at end of 2027
posts.excerpt: The band have teased "new music" and shows to come first, before they "fall dormant as a recording and performing entity" The post Enter Shikari to go on indefinite hiatus at end of 2027 appeared firs
posts.content:
Enter Shikari have confirmed plans to go on an indefinite hiatus at the end of 2027.

The news comes after frontman Rou Reynolds posted a video last month, explaining the band’s lack of activity in 2026. He said he’d “been going through a lot of adversity which has brought my capacity to zero”, citing burnout, OCD and nervous system sensitisation.

READ MORE: Enter Shikari talk surprise new album ‘Lose Your Self’: “At its core, it goes against that idea that we’re divided”

Reynolds noted that Enter Shikari had released their latest album, ‘Lose Your Self’, back in the spring “and then did bugger all”. However, he explained that the break was “very much needed”. The singer went on to speak about “the future of the band”, before promising to update fans “soon”.

Now, the group have posted a lengthy letter to fans via social media where they detailed what’s coming next. This followed the announcement of some intimate warm-up shows for this month, ahead of their biggest-ever UK and European tour in November (find any remaining tickets here).

In the statement, Enter Shikari said they had no plans beyond the end of next year, when they’ll “fall dormant as a recording and performing entity”.

“This dormancy may eventually end with an eruption back into activity, or may end with extinction. We have no idea which,” the message continued. “As everyone keeps reminding us, 2027 will be 20 years since the release of our debut album [‘Take To The Skies’]. We’ve been playing music together since we were 15, and friends longer still, but there’s no doubt this is a huge milestone.”

View this post on Instagram

They went on to note the “obvious negative impact on one’s mental health” when remaining active in a touring band. “But we do this because we love it,” the statement read. “And we are lucky enough to have built an audience who understand that the less-trodden path is sometimes the more interesting journey.

“However, it gets to the point where the often difficult terrain of that path starts to frazzle and drain the humble traveller.”

Enter Shikari admitted that their “priorities and capacities [had] changed” over the years, and said they’d had “difficult conversations about what the next few years should hold” before Reynolds’ health issues.

“While we don’t think we’re ‘splitting up’, we do not have a diary that extends beyond 2027,” they explained.

Enter Shikari, 2026. CREDIT: Kate Hook“We’re genuinely excited to make next year a celebration of what this band means to us. But after that it’ll be time to go away for a good while and see what being Rou, Rob, Rory and Chris, and not ‘Enter Shikari’, feels like.

“Maybe we’ll be like Fugazi and just get together to rehearse for fun, without feeling the need to make anyone else listen to it? All we really know is, after two decades of being a ‘professional’ band, not having plans three years in advance is liberating.”

Looking ahead to next month’s arena tour, Enter Shikari said they’re focused on making the trek the “absolute best it can be”. They wrote: “If that ends up being the last time some people see us, we want to make it special.”

The band also teased that they’d been “working on some bits of new music, which you should get to hear sooner rather than later, along with another thing we’ve just finished filming”.

As for 2027, Reynolds and co. have booked some festival dates in mainland Europe and North America, and plan to announce some US shows for January. Enter Shikari will celebrate the 20th anniversary of ‘Take To The Skies’, while marking 10 years of ‘The Spark’ and 15 years of ‘A Flash Flood Of Colour’.

“If we were better at making the most of things and planning ahead, this whole message would be the precursor to announcing a ‘farewell’ world tour, but.. yeah.. there’s no world tour,” they explained.

“We’ll hopefully get to play some of our favourite places ‘one last time’, but we’re not sure how feasible that is yet.”

The band concluded: “We really hope we’ll be seeing you over the next fourteen months or so, somehow. But, if not, all that remains to be said is thank you for your support, your sweat, your passion, your energy.”

Speaking to NME in April, Reynolds teased a “new” live production for Enter Shikari’s huge UK tour. “We’ve been so focused on the album that we haven’t even dared to open that thought process yet!” he told us. “Luckily, when you have the opportunity to do two nights at Ally Pally, you know that you can bring a lot to the table.”

Around the same time, the band played a tiny gig in Manchester to celebrate the 20th anniversary of their first-ever show in the city.

posts.title: LCD Soundsystem announce 12-night 2026 New York City residency
posts.excerpt: The stint includes a "blowout" to celebrate the band's 100th NYC residency show The post LCD Soundsystem announce 12-night 2026 New York City residency appeared first on NME.
posts.content:
LCD Soundsystem have announced a 12-night residency in New York City for the end of this year. Find all the details below.

READ MORE:  LCD Soundsystem live at Glastonbury 2024: Balearic bliss for a Somerset sunset

The band began their annual year-ending stints in NYC in 2021, after hosting a multi-show takeover at Brooklyn Steel in 2017.

James Murphy and co. played 12 dates at the Knockdown Center in Queens, New York, last November and December. The shows saw them dust off 2005’s ‘Too Much Love for the first time in 14 years.

Now, LCD have confirmed that they’ll be returning to both Brooklyn Steel and the Knockdown Center to see out 2026.

They’ll host 12 performances overall, kicking off with four nights in Queens on November 19, 20, 21 and 22. The group are then scheduled to play Brooklyn Steel on November 30, December 1, 2 and 3.

To conclude the residency, they’ll head back to the Knockdown Center for four gigs on December 10, 11, 12 and 13.

View this post on Instagram

LCD’s November 30 date will mark their 100th NYC residency show. On the official announcement poster, the band promised a selection of guests and DJs for the “100 NYC residency show blowout”.

Tickets go on general sale at 10am ET next Friday (October 9) – you’ll be able to buy yours here. Alternatively, fans can access a pre-sale at the same time on Wednesday (October 7) by registering here. A pre-sale for American Express customers begins at 10am ET on Tuesday (October 6).

LCD Soundsystem’s New York City residency dates for 2026 are:

NOVEMBER
19 – Knockdown Center, Queens
20 – Knockdown Center, Queens
21 – Knockdown Center, Queens
22 – Knockdown Center, Queens
30 – Brooklyn Steel, Brooklyn (100th NYC residency show)

DECEMBER
01 – Brooklyn Steel, Brooklyn
02 – Brooklyn Steel, Brooklyn
03 – Brooklyn Steel, Brooklyn
10 – Knockdown Center, Queens
11 – Knockdown Center, Queens
12 – Knockdown Center, Queens
13 – Knockdown Center, Queens

Meanwhile, LCD Soundsystem are opening for Harry Styles in Rome next summer as part of his ‘Together, Together’ tour. Styles’ fourth solo album, ‘Kiss All The Time. Disco, Occasionally’, was inspired by him seeing LCD live. Earlier this year, frontman Murphy appeared at the pop star’s edition of Meltdown in London.

The band recently wrapped up a North American tour, which included stops at festivals such as Shaky Knees and Just Like Heaven.

LCD Soundsystem hosted a residency at the O2 Academy Brixton in London last year, and co-headlined the Hollywood Bowl with Pulp.

The group haven’t released an album since their 2017 comeback record ‘American Dream’, which itself ended a seven-year break following 2010’s ‘This Is Happening’. It was previously reported that LCD would drop a new LP in 2025, shortly after they shared the single ‘X-Ray Eyes’.

LCD Soundsystem live at Glastonbury 2024. Credit: Andy Ford for NMEMurphy later gave an update about the progress on the album, saying: “So there’s a new LCD song called ‘X-Ray Eyes’. It’s the first single of what’s shaping up to be a new LCD Soundsystem album.

“Don’t ask me when that is, because we are still working on it. But it feels very good to be putting out new music.”

The frontman went on to reiterate that “there is no finished LP yet”, adding: “But when we are not playing shows, it’s getting closer and closer to completion. So that’s the news. Anything else you hear is bullshit speculation.”

A standalone single called ‘New Body Rhumba’, from Noah Baumbach’s film White Noise, arrived in 2022. That same year, Murphy shared a lengthy Facebook post explaining the band’s decision to focus on residencies rather than bigger shows.

posts.title: ‘Resident Evil’ film soundtrack coming to bloody red vinyl
posts.excerpt: The 1LP release features music from Hays and Ryan Holladay The post ‘Resident Evil’ film soundtrack coming to bloody red vinyl appeared first on NME.
posts.content:
The soundtrack to Zach Cregger’s record-breaking Resident Evil film adaptation is getting a blood red vinyl release.

READ MORE: ‘Resident Evil’ review: Zach Cregger injects new life into blood-spattered zombie franchise

Released last month, Cregger’s take on the long-running survival horror franchise has become the best-reviewed video game movie of all time and taken more than $100million at the box office.

And now the film’s original soundtrack, composed by Hays and Ryan Holladay, is getting a vinyl release. The 1LP includes the complete score pressed on blood red vinyl, alongside an insert with exclusive illustrations and liner notes from the director and composers. According to a press release, the music “captures the tension, terror, and pervasive chaos engulfing the city of Raccoon City.”

The Resident Evil film soundtrack vinyl is set to launch in February 2027 but you can pre-order it now via Black Screen Records and Milan.

Drop the needle
⁰The #ResidentEvil soundtrack is now available to pre-order on vinyl.
*Pressed on a 140g red-smoked LP with exclusive artwork and liner notes*

Resident Evil is playing in theatres now. pic.twitter.com/5fFisIHNzr

— Sony Music Soundtracks (@SonySoundtracks) September 25, 2026

You can also stream the soundtrack here.

Rather than a direct adaptation of any of the Resident Evil games, Cregger’s film tells an original story that runs parallel to the events of Resident Evil 2. “In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos,” reads a description of the “thrilling  and terrifying reinvention” of the franchise.

However in the lead up to the film’s release, Cregger had to defend his decision not to adapt one of the game’s storylines. “My only hope is that they’ll see the movie regardless of their skepticism [and] they will recognise all of the love for the games that are in this movie. This is not me just telling a story and slapping Resident Evil on it so I can get a budget. This is me telling a Resident Evil story.”

Following the success of Resident Evil, producer Roy Lee is working on an adaptation of psychological horror Silent Hill.

posts.title: The BRIT Awards 2026 deliver £5million boost to Manchester in first year outside London
posts.excerpt: “It was a recognition not only of our unmatched music heritage, but our growing reputation for putting on national and global events and making a success of them,” said the Mayor of Greater Manchester
posts.content:
A recent study has found that the BRIT Awards moving to Manchester for the first time earlier this year led to a £5million boost in the city.

READ MORE: Jacob Alon on winning BRITs 2026 Critic’s Choice Award: “Music is important and it can make a difference”

This year’s edition of the iconic awards saw the ceremony head to Manchester for the first time ever – marking the first time the ceremony has taken place outside of London in its nearly 50-year history.

Now, ahead of the 2027 edition also taking place in Manchester on Saturday February 27, it has been found that the shift away from London led millions of pounds going into Manchester’s local economy.

The independent study was conducted by AMION Consulting, and found a positive and indisputable footprint in the city and Greater Manchester area. There was a £5 million net additional expenditure in Manchester – £3.6million coming from visitors – as well as £3.45million gross value added.

On top of that, there were over 3,000 one week temporary jobs created, and the social impact could be monetised to the sum of £11.2million.

BRITs 2026 Economic Impact Report poster. CREDIT: PressWith the research, the economic assessment focused on spending retained in Manchester during that time, that would otherwise not have taken place without the BRITs.

Researchers also avoided overstating the impact by excluding excluded ticket income and becoming adjusted for displacement. As well as financial benefits, they also highlighted a noticeable boost in local partnerships, hotel performance, city centre cultural activation and community engagement, and increased visibility for Manchester’s music ecosystem.

In terms of the audience, there were nearly 25,000 people who attended the Award Show and wider events in Manchester, and 92 per cent of Award Show attendees rated the experience as excellent or good, whilst 94 per cent of attendees at wider BRITs events rated them as excellent or good.

“Moving the BRITs to Manchester was about more than moving an awards show. It’s about shining a light on the incredible talent and creative communities across the UK, opening up opportunities, and widening participation,” said Stacey Tang, Co-President of RCA Records at Sony Music UK, and Chair of the BRITs Committee.

“Music can connect people and shape culture, but it also creates jobs, drives investment and inspires future careers. This report captures both sides of that story – the economic impact and the human impact. That’s what makes this such an exciting foundation to build on for the future.”

Olivia Dean performs at BRITs Week for War Child 2026. CREDIT: Aaron ParsonsDr Jo Twist OBE, CEO of the BPI, which owns and organises The BRIT Awards, shared: “We’re delighted that a legacy is being created for the city and its communities, and we look forward to building on that in the coming months as we work with our record label members and all our partners to deliver an even more memorable and impactful series of events in 2027.”

Finally, the Mayor of Greater Manchester, Bev Craig said that while “Manchester is known throughout the world for its incredible music scene”, being able to bring “the BRIT Awards here for the first time was a massive moment for our city region. It was a recognition not only of our unmatched music heritage, but our growing reputation for putting on national and global events and making a success of them.”.

For the 2026 event, Jack Whitehall returned to host for the sixth time, and performances on the night came from Harry Styles, Olivia Dean, HUNTR/X’s EJAE, Audrey Nuna and REI AMI, Wolf Alice, Mark Ronson, Alex Warren, Sombr, RAYE, and Rosalía – the latter of which brought out Björk as a special guest.

Winners included Noel Gallagher, who was named as Songwriter of the Year, as well as PinkPantheress as Producer Of The Year, and Ozzy Osbourne was honoured with the BRITs Lifetime Achievement Award following his passing last summer. Olivia Dean was the artist who took home the most awards on the night.

As well as the awards ceremony, there were also other BRITs related events taking place around Manchester earlier this year, including a city-wide cultural programme and first ever BRITs Fringe. There was also the return of BRITs Week For War Child, which hosted intimate performances from Robbie Williams, Olivia Dean, Jacob Alon, Myles Smith and Lambrini Girls, and raised £1.16million for the charity.

Source: https://www.nme.com/news/music/brit-awards-2026-5million-boost-manchester-outside-london-3971776?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=brit-awards-2026-5million-boost-manchester-outside-london

posts.title: Hasan Piker vows he will pressure James Talarico to govern as a leftist, not a moderate
posts.excerpt: Hasan Piker vowed to pressure James Talarico to govern as a leftist if elected, not a moderate Democrat, raising questions about the Texas Senate race.
posts.content:
Left-wing streamer Hasan Piker vowed Wednesday that he would push Democratic Texas Senate candidate James Talarico to govern as a leftist rather than a moderate Democrat if Talarico was elected.

"Hopefully after James Talarico wins, we’ve got to hold him to account," Piker said during a campus event at the University of Texas at Austin. "We've got to make sure that he doesn’t become another, ‘do nothing Democrat’ ‘business as usual’ and we've got to keep up that pressure."

"We have to remind him that we are the force that backed him both early on," he continued. "We are the force that allowed him to win this seat of power and if he wants to maintain it, he’s got to play ball. Right?"

"And, that’s good to build a resilient movement anyway, so job’s not done even after he wins," Piker added. "So, just remember that, and you know, remember that we do hold a lot of power in mass organizing."

UNIVERSITY EVENT WITH HASAN PIKER IN TEXAS DRAWS BACKLASH FROM BOTH SIDES OF THE AISLE

Fox News Digital reached out to Talarico's campaign for comment but did not immediately receive a response.

Talarico has moderated his rhetoric during his run for Senate, disavowing some of his past statements.

Piker, an internet personality popular on the Twitch platform, has become a major player in left-wing politics in recent years and has a long history of controversial comments, ranging from saying "America deserved 9/11" to praising an official in New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's administration after a clip showed her saying she wanted to "impoverish the White middle-class."

Proximity to Piker has been a lightning rod for Democrats. Since the left-wing streamer appeared with Michigan Democratic Senate nominee Abdul El-Sayed on the campaign trail, the candidate repeatedly tried to shrug off Piker’s controversial remarks.

TALARICO’S ‘PROUD CAPITALIST’ ABOUT-FACE COLLIDES WITH RESURFACED CALL TO ‘DISMANTLE’ CAPITALISM

Jesse Arm, a Manhattan Institute vice president and pollster from Michigan, wondered whether Talarico’s avowed moderation will stick.

"Talarico is wise to acknowledge, in effect, that many of his past comments on key policy questions were absurd, but Texans have reason to wonder whether his convictions have changed or merely his political incentives," he told Fox News Digital. "If he is as wise a lawmaker as he is a crafty politician, he will govern as the more moderate liberal he currently purports to be."

"Hasan Piker’s faction can certainly exert pressure," he added. "And I would expect it to push Talarico back toward his earlier, more radical positions on policing, gender, race, immigration, and energy."

A better indicator, he argued, was the fact that genuinely moderate Democrats have been driven out of office.

"We cannot know how Talarico would govern, but the broader Democratic Party gives us plenty of reason for skepticism: Joe Manchin and Kyrsten Sinema were driven out, and John Fetterman faces endless hostility for breaking with its activist orthodoxy," he said. "Governing as a genuine moderate would give Talarico a better chance of keeping a Texas Senate seat beyond an unusually favorable Democratic election cycle, but Piker is already openly demanding that he ‘play ball’ with the far left."

Arm suggested that Piker might actually be making a tactical mistake by suggesting Democrats are only campaigning as moderates, but will govern like leftists.

"Above perhaps all else, this episode exposes Piker’s political stupidity: publicly suggesting that a candidate’s moderation is temporary and that radicals will call the shots threatens the very victory he claims to want," Arm said. "In truth, I suspect Piker would prefer an election cycle in which Talarico comes up short but El-Sayed gets across the finish line. That would help advance Piker’s position that radicalism is the only viable path forward for the Democratic Party."

CLICK HERE FOR MORE COVERAGE OF MEDIA AND CULTURE

Former Democratic advisor Dan Turrentine suggested that Piker has vastly overestimated his importance both now and after the election.

"Hasan Piker is living in fantasy world," he said. "He did not elect Talarico in the primary. Progressives were split, with many going for Jasmine Crockett."

"If Talarico wins the general, it will be because he appealed to a significant number of R’s in a state Trump won by 14% in ’24," Turrentine continued. "If Talarico wins, it will be in spite of Piker, not because of him."

"Same, if they win, for Roy Cooper in NC, Josh Turek in IA, Mary Peltola in AK, and Sherrod Brown in OH," he added. "The Senate majority runs through the middle of the electorate, not Twitch."

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/media/hasan-piker-vows-he-pressure-james-talarico-govern-leftist-not-moderate

posts.title: College professor accused of sending explicit Snapchat messages in child solicitation case: sheriff's office
posts.excerpt: Aaron Wood, a Texas professor, allegedly sent sexually explicit photos and messages online to an undercover Florida officer he believed was a 14-year-old boy.
posts.content:
Texas officials last week arrested a Dallas-area community college professor accused of sending sexually explicit photos and messages online to an individual he believed was a 14-year-old boy.

Aaron Wood, 34, who taught drama for two years at North Central Texas College (NCTC), allegedly sent the messages on Snapchat to an undercover agent in Florida May 22.

The Denton County Sheriff’s Office arrested Wood Friday and charged him with solicitation of a minor via computer, according to county records.

The school confirmed his arrest in a statement, saying he was no longer employed as of Monday.

FORMER TEXAS HIGH SCHOOL TEACHER ARRESTED AFTER PROBE INTO INAPPROPRIATE STUDENT RELATIONSHIP

NCTC added the alleged offense did not involve any school staff or students.

"To our knowledge, the alleged offense does not involve NCTC, its students or staff," the college said. "We can verify that he has had no contact with NCTC students, faculty or staff since his arrest on September 25, 2026."

According to an arrest affidavit, Wood allegedly engaged in an online conversation on Snapchat with an undercover officer from the Orange County Sheriff’s Office in Florida, FOX 4 Dallas reported.

During their interaction, Wood reportedly told the undercover officer he teaches students around the same age as the person he believed he was speaking with.

FLORIDA MIDDLE SCHOOL TEACHER ADMITS TO YEARS OF 'INAPPROPRIATE' CONVERSATIONS WITH FORMER STUDENT: DEPUTIES

When asked about his students, Wood allegedly told the officer he had "been into a few over the years" and that he was nervous but still interested in chatting with the undercover officer.

The affidavit says Wood sent a picture of male genitals, along with other sexually explicit messages, to the officer and asked to see theirs, FOX 4 reported.

Authorities tracked Wood through the IP address used during the interaction, which led them to an apartment in Denton.

FORMER NORTH TEXAS POLICE OFFICER GIVEN THREE LIFE SENTENCES FOR CHILD PORNOGRAPHY, SOLICITATION OF MINOR

The affidavit noted that the Orange County Sheriff’s Office had probable cause to charge Wood with transmission of harmful material to minors and unlawful use of a two-way communication device, FOX 4 reported.

While the allegations reportedly did not involve any NCTC students, the school emphasized that "the safety of our students and staff are of the utmost importance and concern."

Fox News Digital reached out to NCTC for additional information.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/us/college-professor-accused-sending-explicit-snapchat-messages-child-solicitation-case-sheriffs-office

posts.title: GREGG JARRETT: My mother’s advice led me to the career of a lifetime
posts.excerpt: Former trial lawyer Gregg Jarrett reflects on leaving his legal career behind and finding purpose during nearly 25 years at the network's news operation.
posts.content:
Decades ago, when I was agonizing over the decision to forsake my profession as a trial lawyer to pursue a far riskier and more uncertain career in television news, my mother offered sage advice. "The worst thing you can do is choose the easy course and be haunted by regret over what might have been."

I embraced her counsel, realizing that the only thing scarier than change is the absence of imagination. I quit my secure and lucrative job as an attorney in San Francisco and moved forward into the unknown. Fortunately, I was too naive to understand that the chances of success were remote.

I discovered that change hurts. It can be difficult and discouraging. But the fear of failure forced me to persevere. My early ventures up the ladder from local news channels to larger network operations felt like Churchill’s "wilderness years." It was a long slog in search of advancement and fulfillment. Self-doubt was always hovering nearby.

DANA PERINO: THE UNTOLD STORY OF THE REMARKABLE PEOPLE WHO MAKE FOX NEWS POSSIBLE

But all of that vanished when I landed at Fox News nearly a quarter of a century ago. I have been grateful ever since to have played a small role in a network that has changed the face of television news for the better.

I could tell at the outset that the people at Fox were different. They were dedicated and passionate. The common denominator was an unwavering commitment to excellence. We supported one another.

But the heart and soul of our network are the viewers themselves. They watch with consistency because they trust what they see and hear. They feel engaged. In turn, those of us on air and the many people behind the scenes do our level best to maintain that trust by providing the highest-quality news and information available.

As a 24-hour news operation, that level of devotion and diligence is not easy to sustain. Yet I am consistently impressed by the energy, creativity, and intelligence that my colleagues bring to the on-air product every hour of every day. They are tireless and enthusiastic even when they have every right not to be. Those are rare qualities.

MARTHA MACCALLUM: AFTER 22 YEARS, HERE'S WHY I'M GRATEFUL TO CALL FOX HOME

During my many years at Fox, I have covered a multitude of stories—the War on Terror, hurricanes, disasters, presidential elections, the dot-com crash, financial calamities, social upheavals, cultural controversies, criminal trials, Supreme Court decisions, and the COVID-19 pandemic, to name a few.

Fox never said "no" when I wanted to venture beyond the newsroom. They encouraged it.

Having previously reported from conflict zones in the Middle East, I volunteered in 2003 as a correspondent during the Iraq War. For a time, I was embedded with the 3rd Infantry Division. These were courageous young soldiers who took good care of me. The experience gave me a renewed respect and admiration for our nation’s military. There are none better anywhere.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE FOX NEWS OPINION

The world has changed dramatically since I first stepped into the Fox studios back in 2002. America has become more digital, diverse, and technologically advanced. Smartphones, e-commerce, social media, cloud computing, and now AI have transformed our lives. The Dow Jones Industrial Average hovered around 10,000 back then. It now exceeds 50,000.

In my time at Fox News, I have served as an anchor, reporter, documentary host, opinion columnist, and, most recently, legal analyst for the network. I penned four books along the way. I have grown and evolved in ways that I never imagined. Fox made that possible. And I’ve enjoyed every minute of it.

It has certainly been a different life than what I envisioned as a young man exiting law school so long ago. Far more rewarding. During the journey, I learned some valuable lessons. Sometimes it pays to take a chance. And to listen to your mother.

So, may I offer my sincere thanks to Fox News and a hearty congratulations on its 30th anniversary!

CLICK HERE TO READ MORE FROM GREGG JARRETT

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/opinion/gregg-jarrett-mothers-advice-led-career-lifetime

posts.title: DOE employee charged with trying to aid Iran-backed Houthis, feds say
posts.excerpt: Ashton Hamed Ellaboudy allegedly used his electrical engineering expertise in an attempt to aid Houthi communications, drones and homemade explosives production.
posts.content:
A U.S. Department of Energy worker from Richland, Washington, was arrested Thursday and charged with attempting to provide "material support" to the Iran-backed Houthis, according to the Department of Justice (DOJ).

Ashton Hamed Ellaboudy, 51, is accused of attempting to use his electrical engineering knowledge and background to support the terrorist group in improving its mobile communications infrastructure, secure components for drones as well as chemicals for homemade explosives.

"As alleged, a U.S. government employee traveled overseas and used his specialized expertise in an attempt to aid the Houthis, a designated Foreign Terrorist Organization backed by Iran," Assistant Attorney General for National Security John A. Eisenberg said in a statement.

"Additionally, Ellaboudy acquired materials for the construction of explosive material and drones capable of delivering these explosives. These allegations are so deeply disturbing that they almost defy imagination."

IRAN’S PROXY WAR HAS CROSSED OCEANS AND IS NOW KNOCKING ON AMERICA’S DOOR

Federal authorities took Ellaboudy into custody after an investigation by the FBI’s Inland Northwest Joint Terrorism Task Force.

According to court records, Ellaboudy first attracted the FBI’s attention after he allegedly bought precursor chemicals, or starting ingredients, and components often used in homemade explosives, as well as parts to make drones.

The DOJ said that, in 2024, Ellaboudy took sick leave from his Department of Energy job and said he had been exposed to highly concentrated nitric acid, a key chemical compound used in explosive manufacturing.

FBI OFFERS $200K REWARD FOR FORMER AIR FORCE INTELLIGENCE AGENT ACCUSED OF SPYING FOR IRAN

In 2025, prosecutors allege, Ellaboudy used an official passport from his previous role with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers to travel from Washington state to Oman.

He then crossed into Yemen. After returning to the U.S., Ellaboudy allegedly told border officers his trip was authorized government business.

Investigators also said Ellaboudy advised an undercover FBI confidential human source posing as a representative of a Houthi colonel.

For the Houthis, Ellaboudy allegedly tested solar generators, modified power systems, created circuit schematics and provided support to the group’s communications, the statement said.

NAVY VETERAN AMONG TRIO WHO ALLEGEDLY WANTED TO BEHEAD SOLDIER AND FUND ISIS DRONE ATTACKS ON AMERICANS

"This individual allegedly betrayed the U.S. and attempted to aid the Houthis, a designated foreign terrorist organization, but thanks to the work of the men and women of the FBI, his actions were detected, and he is now in custody," Assistant Director Jarod Brown of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division said.

Officials also confirmed Ellaboudy's alleged activities did not target local nuclear sites.

"This matter did not involve an attempt to harm the Hanford Site or its workforce, and at no time was there a threat to the safety or security of the site," said Ray Geimer, office manager of the Department of Energy Hanford Field Office.

Ellaboudy faces a maximum penalty of 20 years in prison if convicted.

He is scheduled to make his initial court appearance before a federal magistrate judge at 11 a.m. Oct. 2 in Richland, according to the Justice Department.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/world/doe-employee-charged-trying-aid-iran-backed-houthis-feds-say

posts.title: Putin demands UN reform against Western countries’ influence
posts.excerpt: Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday called for urgent reform at the United Nations to allow countries from all continents to make meaningful contributions. Putin addressed the plenary session
posts.content:
Russian President Vladimir Putin on Thursday called for urgent reform at the United Nations to allow countries from all continents to make meaningful contributions.

Putin addressed the plenary session of the 23rd annual meeting of the Valdai Discussion Club, themed “Responsibility for the Future: Limits of the Possible, or Limitless Possibilities?”

Referencing the UN Charter, the President stressed that the document stipulates that the UN operates as a central coordinating mechanism in international affairs.

Putin said despite being the most representative international organisation, the UN falls short of collective and democratic principles in the way it is being managed compared to its original design.

“A narrow grouping of Western countries wields a disproportionately large influence,” he noted. “It constitutes a global minority by all accounts while seeking to appropriate administrative functions.”

Putin observed that the imbalance within the UN system is increasingly obvious, as countries see their influence diminish and are “taken over by a more independent and confident global majority.”

Reiterating his country’s advocacy of a fair reform of the UN, the President believes such an amendment is impossible without internal consensus that is difficult to achieve today.

Russia wants a UN structure that fully reflects global diversity so that countries from Asia, Africa, Latin America and the Middle East can play “a far more significant role.”

UN reform, according to Putin, entails more than expanding the Security Council or adopting measures for a more balanced geographical representation in international governing bodies.

It also involves redefining the UN’s substance and priorities, including future ones, “given that global changes are creating a list of new dilemmas that did not exist before,” the President said.

Putin demands UN reform against Western countries’ influence

posts.title: LaLiga: Real Madrid submit documents to strip Barça of titles, remove them from Europe
posts.excerpt: Real Madrid have requested that Barcelona be stripped of the titles won between 2001 and 2018 in connection with UEFA’s investigation into the Negreira case. According to Spanish publication Diario AS
posts.content:
Real Madrid have requested that Barcelona be stripped of the titles won between 2001 and 2018 in connection with UEFA’s investigation into the Negreira case.

According to Spanish publication Diario AS, Real Madrid have submitted documentation to UEFA regarding the matter.

The submission by Real Madrid reportedly comprises 50,000 pages of materials, including numerous documents, evidence and statements from multiple parties. UEFA has formally initiated a disciplinary investigation into the Negreira case.

European football’s governing body is investigating Barcelona’s €8.4 million payment to José María Enríquez Negreira.

The payment was made to Negreira, who served as vice-president of the Technical Committee of Referees between 2001 and 2018.

The matter became public in April 2023, and UEFA president Aleksander Čeferin described it as among the most serious allegations in football history.

Following a three-and-a-half-year delay attributed to judicial proceedings, Real Madrid have now intensified the matter. UEFA is currently reviewing the materials submitted by Real Madrid.

Real Madrid are seeking the removal of all titles Barcelona won between 2001 and 2018. Additionally, UEFA possesses the authority to exclude Barcelona from European competitions pursuant to Article 4 of UEFA’s regulatory framework.

posts.excerpt: Less than a day after the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) reduced the price of Premium Motor Spirit (PMS) to N1,370 per litre, the state-owned oil company has offered Nigerians an
posts.content:
Less than a day after the Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPCL) reduced the price of Premium Motor Spirit (PMS) to N1,370 per litre, the state-owned oil company has offered Nigerians an N66 discount.

NNPCL made this disclosure in a notice on X on Thursday, in commemoration of Nigeria’s 66th Independence Anniversary.

According to NNPCL, Nigerians will benefit from a significant N66 per litre discount at any of its retail outlets from October 1 to 7, 2026.

However, NNPCL said Nigerians would have to use its mobile app to benefit from the offer.

“Happy 66th Independence Day, Nigeria.

“N66 off every litre of PMS at NNPC Retail today till 7 October. Pay with the app at any participating station. T&Cs apply,” NNPCL stated.

Recall that on Wednesday, NNPCL filling stations in Abuja and its environs reduced their fuel price by N25 per litre to N1,370 after Dangote Refinery cut its gantry petrol price to N1,325 per litre.

Earlier, MRS filling stations in Abuja dropped their fuel pump price to N1,370 per litre.

This means that Nigerians in Abuja and its surrounding areas can buy petrol for between N1,370 and N1,450 per litre.
