posts.title: Florida Gators run into buzzsaw in Missouri, Tigers shred top-ten team for rare ranked win at home
posts.excerpt: Austin Simmons threw for 340 yards and two scores as the Missouri Tigers demolished the No. 8 Florida Gators 45-17, holding Jadan Baugh to 13 yards.
posts.content:
The Florida Gators certainly aren't the 2019 LSU Tigers.

They might not even be the 2019 version of the Florida Gators.

The number eight team in the country traveled to Columbia, Missouri, and ran into an absolute buzzsaw, as the Tigers took the Gators behind the woodshed in a 45-17 victory on Saturday.

FLORIDA GATORS FACE MISSOURI TIGERS IN COLLEGE FOOTBALL MATCHUP WHERE THE OVER LOOKS LIKE THE PLAY

It seemed like anything that could go right for Mizzou did.

The Tigers were able to establish their dominance on both lines of scrimmage, putting up 560 total yards and holding Florida to a shockingly low 42 yards on the ground.

Jadan Baugh, who came into the game leading the SEC in rushing yards, could hardly get it going this afternoon, only rushing for 13 yards on 12 carries.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE

That was by design, as head coach Eli Drinkwitz revealed in his post game presser on the field.

While Baugh entered the day with Heisman aspirations, it was Missouri quarterback Austin Simmons who put on an award-winning performance.

The former Ole Miss starter was about as perfect as anyone could have asked for, eviscerating Florida's secondary to the tune of 340 yards and two scores through the air.

Missouri showed a ton of resolve, regrouping from their loss last week to Mississippi State and winning a home game against a ranked opponent for the first time since 2024.

For the Gators, Faurot Field has proved to be a house of horrors, and Saturday afternoon was no different.

The game was never close after halftime, and at no point did the usually explosive Florida offense look threatening to the home team.

Now, first year head coach Jon Sumrall will have to regroup and answer some tough questions.

It doesn't get any easier for the Gators either.

South Carolina comes to town, then Florida goes to Austin to take on Texas before a bye week.

Then the Gators will take on archrival Georgia in Atlanta.

That stretch will tell everyone in Gainesville what this team and their new head coach is all about.

Florida didn't handle being a top-ten team very well, and now they'll have to do a bit of climbing to get back to that spot.

For the time being, however, this one will sting.

posts.title: Texas woman charged with shooting two sons dead
posts.excerpt: A 42-year-old Texas woman, Colleen Nichole Lemmon has been charged with two counts of capital murder after authorities alleged that she shot her two sons inside their home before apparently injuring h
posts.content:
A 42-year-old Texas woman, Colleen Nichole Lemmon has been charged with two counts of capital murder after authorities alleged that she shot her two sons inside their home before apparently injuring herself.

Lemmon was arrested following the deaths of 21-year-old Christopher Scott Pitre and his 15-year-old brother in Waxahachie, Texas.

According to the Ellis County Sheriff’s Office, deputies were dispatched to a residence on Big Sky Drive shortly before 4:15 a.m. on Thursday after receiving a report of an “

unknown emergency.

Upon arrival, officers found both brothers with gunshot wounds inside the house.

Christopher was pronounced dead at the scene, while his younger brother was taken to hospital in critical condition. He later died from his injuries.

Lemmon was also found injured at the residence and was taken to hospital for treatment before being arrested.

An arrest affidavit cited in local reports stated that Lemmon was covered in blood and had what appeared to be self-inflicted cuts on her wrists. A handgun was also reportedly found nearby.

Authorities said evidence recovered from the residence gave investigators probable cause to believe that Lemmon had shot both of her sons.

According to the affidavit, Lemmon allegedly told responding officers, “I shot both my kids.”

The father of the victims, Scott Pitre, said his younger son had only recently celebrated his 15th birthday, adding that he wanted justice for his children.

A neighbour, Ida Brown, described the incident as heartbreaking and said she was praying for the family.

Ellis County Sheriff Brad Norman also expressed sympathy to the victims’ relatives.

“My deepest sympathies go out to the victims’ father, family members, and loved ones involved in this tragic incident,” Norman said.

“They will remain in our prayers during this difficult time.”

Lemmon is being held on a $2.5m bond.

Authorities have not disclosed a motive for the killings, and investigations into the circumstances surrounding the deaths are ongoing.

Texas woman charged with shooting two sons dead

posts.title: Two killed as gunmen attack another mining site in Plateau
posts.excerpt: Two miners were shot dead on Friday night by gunmen suspected to be Fulani militias at a mining site in Kuru Jenta of Heipang District in Barkin Ladi Local Government Area of Plateau State. The Nation
posts.content:
Two miners were shot dead on Friday night by gunmen suspected to be Fulani militias at a mining site in Kuru Jenta of Heipang District in Barkin Ladi Local Government Area of Plateau State.

The National Publicity Secretary of the Berom Youth Moulders Association, BYM, Rwang Tengwong, who confirmed the attack in a statement made available to journalists on Saturday, said the incident occurred at about 11:30 pm while the victims and other miners were carrying out activities at the site.

Tengwong, who described the attack as unprovoked and unfortunate, said it came barely a week after gunmen killed two other miners at another mining site in Rakum village of Jos South LGA.

Tengwon urged security agencies to investigate the incident, identify those responsible, and bring them to justice.

The BYM spokesman further cautioned residents, particularly miners, against mining at night, urging them to remain vigilant and comply with security measures put in place by the government.

He particularly lamented the fact that the attack came at a time when the state government had imposed a curfew on three local government areas, including Barkin Ladi, where the incident took place.

He urged residents to respect the restricted hours, remain vigilant, and avoid activities that could expose them to security risks, while also taking necessary precautions in view of the prevailing security situation in the area.

posts.title: Tinubu saved Nigeria from economic collapse – VP Shettima
posts.excerpt: Vice President Kashim Shettima has said President Bola Tinubu’s economic reforms prevented Nigeria from sliding into a deeper crisis and saved the country from economic collapse. Shettima made the sta
posts.content:
Vice President Kashim Shettima has said President Bola Tinubu’s economic reforms prevented Nigeria from sliding into a deeper crisis and saved the country from economic collapse.

Shettima made the statement on Saturday while speaking with journalists shortly after meeting with Tinubu in Lagos.

Defending the administration’s economic policies, the Vice President said Nigeria’s foreign reserves were below $3.9bn when the Tinubu administration assumed office, arguing that the country’s economy was already approaching a critical point.

“When we assumed the mantle of leadership, our foreign reserves were a staggering below $3.9 billion that was not enough to import fuel for one month,” Shettima said.

He credited Tinubu’s “courage and conviction” for decisions including the removal of the fuel subsidy and the unification of the country’s multiple exchange rates.

“The withdrawal of the fuel subsidy, the realignment of the multiple exchange rate were far-reaching decisions.

“The economy was actually on the verge of collapse. He saved the economy,” the Vice President said.

“I want Nigerians to understand this fundamental truism. We were on the road to Caracas. He saved our economy; he saved the nation from falling into pieces.”

Shettima acknowledged the economic difficulties confronting Nigerians but said the Federal Government was implementing measures intended to reduce the impact of the hardship on citizens.

“We appreciate the pains Nigerians are going through, but tough times do not last forever; tough people do,” he noted.

“The government is rolling out programmes and projects to assuage the pains of our people.”

According to the Vice President, the administration would introduce additional initiatives in the coming weeks, including an e-logistics scheme in the North-West and electric tricycles in the North-East.

He said the President had “empathy for the common man”, adding that the planned interventions were aimed at easing transportation and economic pressures.

“In the next couple of weeks, we are going to launch e-logistics in the North-West. We are going to launch 10,600 electric tricycles to ease the pains of the people in the North-East, and 300 buses and e-taxis; all these are meant to ameliorate the suffering of our people,” he added.

Saturday’s meeting in Lagos was the first public engagement between Tinubu and Shettima since the President returned from his European vacation. It also marked their first public interaction since the Vice President returned from the 81st United Nations General Assembly, UNGA, in New York.

In a national broadcast marking Nigeria’s 66th Independence Day anniversary, Tinubu had said the country was on the path to prosperity.

However, opposition figures, including former Vice President Atiku Abubakar of the African Democratic Congress, ADC, and Peter Obi of the Nigeria Democratic Congress, NDC, challenged the administration’s assessment of the economy.

Atiku accused the Tinubu administration of worsening poverty since it came into office in 2023, while Obi said Nigerians were facing increased hardship amid worsening hunger and insecurity.

Tinubu saved Nigeria from economic collapse – VP Shettima

Source: https://dailypost.ng/2026/10/04/tinubu-saved-nigeria-from-economic-collapse-vp-shettima/

posts.title: Soludo swears in council chairmen, demands accountability
posts.excerpt: By Vincent Ujumadu Anambra State Governor, Prof. Chukwuma Soludo, has sworn in the newly elected 21 local government chairmen and their deputies, charging them to prioritise service delivery, accounta
posts.content:
By Vincent Ujumadu

Anambra State Governor, Prof. Chukwuma Soludo, has sworn in the newly elected 21 local government chairmen and their deputies, charging them to prioritise service delivery, accountability and responsible use of public resources.

The governor urged the officials to take their oath of office seriously, review it regularly and consider displaying it in visible locations as a constant reminder of their responsibilities.

“As you begin your journey, know that it is a call to serve,” Soludo told the chairmen, urging them to be their brothers’ and sisters’ keepers, which he said was in line with the agenda of the ruling All Progressives Grand Alliance (APGA).

He said the officials should put aside their expectations and immediately focus on the responsibilities of office.

“I know that when you were applying for the job, you had all manner of aspirations, promises and expectations. Welcome to the world of reality and the clock starts ticking today. The work has already begun,” he said.

Soludo also emphasised the need for the officials to account for their time in office, noting that even the minutes spent at the swearing-in ceremony had already become part of their official responsibilities.

The governor noted what he described as APGA’s dominance in Anambra State over the past 20 years, saying the party’s candidates had, in the latest council election, faced little opposition in many areas.

He reminded the chairmen that previous administrations had helped build the structures on which they were assuming office, urging them to leave the local government system stronger for their successors.

Soludo also urged the new council leaders to embrace innovation while ensuring that their actions remained within the law.

He specifically called for measures to make the local government system more sustainable, noting that the new local government laws permitted councils to pool resources for the effective management of common financial obligations.

The governor advised the chairmen to study the handover notes from their predecessors and carefully assess the assets and liabilities they had inherited, given the challenges confronting the councils.

The swearing-in followed the declaration of the results of the local government election conducted on August 30, 2026.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/soludo-swears-in-council-chairmen-demands-accountability/

posts.title: IGP deploys DIG, CPs to Imo for corps members’ rescue
posts.excerpt: By Kingsley Omonobi The Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Rilwan Disu, has deployed the Deputy Inspector-General of Police in charge of Operations, DIG Shehu Umar Nadada, to Imo State to coordinat
posts.content:
By Kingsley Omonobi

The Inspector-General of Police, Olatunji Rilwan Disu, has deployed the Deputy Inspector-General of Police in charge of Operations, DIG Shehu Umar Nadada, to Imo State to coordinate the rescue of prospective National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) members and other passengers abducted along the Owerri-Onitsha Expressway on Thursday, October 1, 2026.

The Force Public Relations Officer, CSP Aniete Etuk, disclosed this in a statement issued on Saturday in Abuja.

According to the statement, Nadada arrived in Imo with two Commissioners of Police and conducted an on-the-spot assessment of the situation and the ongoing search-and-rescue operation.

The statement said the DIG also reviewed the operational strategies, deployment of personnel and operational assets, and issued further directives to strengthen the coordinated response.

The assessment was conducted alongside the Imo State Commissioner of Police, CP Audu Bosso; the Commissioner of Police in charge of Federal Operations, CP Akpan Anifiok; the Commissioner of Police in charge of the Police Mobile Force; other service commanders and members of the management team of the Imo State Police Command.

The police said the search-and-rescue operation had been intensified, with additional tactical teams and operational assets deployed to identified areas, supported by intelligence-led tracking of the abductors.

The statement said the police were also working closely with other security agencies to secure the safe rescue of the abducted persons and apprehend those responsible.

The statement quoted Nadada as assuring the public that the Nigeria Police Force remained committed to rescuing the 20 abducted persons and would sustain the operation until its conclusion.

He urged members of the public and the media to remain calm and vigilant, while calling on anyone with credible information that could assist the operation to contact the police or the nearest security formation.

The statement assured that all information received would be treated with strict confidentiality and that further updates would be provided as the operation progresses.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/igp-deploys-dig-cps-to-imo-for-corps-members-rescue/

posts.title: Iranian UN delegation duo ‘kicked out’ of US – State Dept
posts.excerpt: One member of the delegation left Friday night, while the second departed Saturday morning, according to Axios. The post Iranian UN delegation duo ‘kicked out’ of US – State Dept appeared first on Van
posts.content:
The United States has “kicked out” two members of the Iranian delegation who attended the recent UN General Assembly after they ignored an order to leave the country, the State Department said Saturday.

“Two more members of the Iranian delegation were found still in (New York) long after the United Nations General Assembly had passed. They have now been kicked out of the US,” a US official told AFP, adding that Secretary of State Marco Rubio “means business.”

US media reported the State Department had told Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and his delegation to leave the country Monday, and resorted to expelling the two members after learning from the Iranian mission to the UN they remained in the country on Friday.

One member of the delegation left Friday night, while the second departed Saturday morning, according to Axios.

US and Iranian officials had met the week prior in New York on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.

US President Donald Trump had rejected a proposal from Tehran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but told US media he expected talks to resume in the coming days.

Iranian state news agency IRNA reported that Tehran had no more direct talks scheduled with Washington.

posts.title: Benue Boat Mishap: Govt arrests boat driver, suspends maritime workers’ union
posts.excerpt: Government also ordered the suspension of the line operator and directed the arrest and detention of the boat skipper involved in the mishap. The post Benue Boat Mishap: Govt arrests boat driver, susp
posts.content:
By Peter Duru, Makurdi

The Benue State government has suspended the Buruku crossing point branch of the Nigeria Union of Maritime Workers, NUMW, following Saturday’s boat mishap, with several passengers still unaccounted for.

The state Commissioner for Marine and Blue Economy, Denis Iyaghigba, ordered the immediate suspension of the union after conducting an on-the-spot assessment of the scene of the accident.

The Commissioner also ordered the suspension of the line operator and directed the arrest and detention of the boat skipper involved in the mishap.

The measures, according to the government, were part of immediate steps to prevent a recurrence of the incident and ensure compliance with safety regulations at the state’s waterways.

The government, in a statement issued by the Head, Media and Public Orientation, Office of the Commissioner for Marine and Blue Economy, Lubem Gena, said the Ministry had activated its search and rescue operations following the accident.

It said the search operation was being conducted in collaboration with local divers to intensify efforts to locate passengers who remained unaccounted for.

According to the statement, “the Benue state government has suspended the Buruku crossing point branch of the Nigeria Union of Maritime Workers, NUMW, following Saturday’s boat mishap in which several passengers remain unaccounted for despite the rescue of others.”

The Commissioner, who visited the scene of the incident, also directed that the line operator be suspended while the boat skipper be arrested and detained pending further investigation into the circumstances surrounding the accident.

The statement quoted Iyaghigba as saying that the government was determined to establish what led to the mishap and take measures to prevent similar incidents on the state’s waterways.

“The Ministry has since activated its search and rescue processes and is working with local divers to intensify the search and rescue,” the Commissioner said.

He disclosed that an inter-ministerial committee had also been constituted to investigate the incident and establish its immediate, remote and underlying causes.

Iyaghigba said the committee would interrogate the circumstances surrounding the mishap and make recommendations aimed at strengthening safety standards at river crossing points across the state.

He further ordered strict compliance with the mandatory use of life jackets at all river crossing points in the state.

According to him, the directive was part of measures to strengthen safety and protect passengers using waterways across Benue.

The Commissioner also raised concern over an abandoned barge at the crossing point which was believed to have contributed to the accident. He consequently gave the owner of the abandoned barge a seven-day ultimatum to evacuate it from the crossing point or risk having it confiscated by the state government.

The statement said the Commissioner would work closely with relevant Ministries, Departments and Agencies, MDAs, during the week to further interrogate the circumstances surrounding the accident and strengthen safety measures across the state’s waterways.

“The government said further details would be made available, but at the moment, investigations and rescue efforts continue,” the statement added.

The latest development followed the boat mishap at the Buruku crossing point on Saturday morning where a wooden boat conveying passengers capsized while crossing the River Katsina-Ala.

Several passengers were rescued following the accident, while others were reported missing, prompting the activation of search and rescue operations by the state government.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/benue-boat-mishap-govt-arrests-boat-driver-suspends-maritime-workers-union/

posts.title: Brain surgery in 2015 affected my penis – Julius Agwu
posts.excerpt: Nigerian comedian and actor Julius Agwu has opened up about a personal complication which followed the brain surgery he had in the United States. The post Brain surgery in 2015 affected my penis – Jul
posts.content:
Nigerian comedian and actor Julius Agwu has opened up about a personal complication which followed the brain surgery he had in the United States.

Agwu underwent brain surgery in 2015 after doctors reportedly discovered three tumours in his brain. One of the tumours was said to be about the size of a golf ball.

Agwu disclosed that he experienced a loss of sexual function after the procedure, revealing the previously little-discussed impact during a recent episode of the Beer Parlour Talk Show uploaded on Saturday.

The comedian was discussing the effects of his health battle on his body, career and personal life when the host asked if the brain condition or surgery had affected other aspects of his health, including his sexual function.

Agwu responded, “After I do am, prick no dey work again now. He no dey work.”

Other participants on the programme, including Mr Patrick, subsequently discussed the nerve involved in the surgery and its connection to the brain as they sought to explain the effect Agwu described.

Agwu also reflected on his influence on Nigeria’s comedy industry, particularly his role in popularising the combination of music and comedy.

“Music comedy na me form am o, that is to tell you how my brain dey work,” he said.

The conversation later became emotional as Agwu broke down in tears while reflecting on his career, relationships and the people he felt abandoned him during his difficult period.

“God wey I dey serve, anybody wey get hand for wetin happen to me. I go dey look. My friends deserted me. They stopped talking to me, many of them. It is well,” he said.

Source: https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/10/brain-surgery-in-2015-affected-my-penis-julius-agwu/

posts.title: Death Toll From Plateau Road Crash Rises To 21
posts.excerpt: Road accidents continue to claim lives and leave many others injured on Nigeria’s roads, with multiple-vehicle collisions recorded on major highways and inter-state routes. The post Death Toll From Pl
posts.content:
The death toll from the multiple road crashes along the Hawan Kibo Road in Riyom Local Government Area of Plateau State has risen to 21.

The Sector Commander of the Federal Road Safety Corps in the state, Corps Commander Adelaja Ogungbemi, who visited the scene alongside the Zonal Commanding Officer, Assistant Corps Marshal, Joseph Udoabba, disclosed the latest figure after assessing the crash site on Saturday.

The officials inspected the scene and the extent of damage caused by the accident, which occurred on Friday evening when a truck reportedly suffered brake failure and rammed into other vehicles travelling towards Jos.

The crash involved a truck, a Hummer bus and a motorcycle.

The Hummer bus caught fire following the impact, while several victims were trapped in the vehicle.

Speaking after the assessment, the FRSC officials urged motorists to exercise greater caution while driving and ensure that their vehicles are properly maintained.

They urged vehicle owners to carry out regular checks of critical vehicle components, particularly braking systems, as these are essential to preventing avoidable road crashes and loss of life.

The FRSC has also continued efforts to manage traffic around the scene and facilitate the removal of the affected vehicles and recovery of the victims.

Road accidents continue to claim lives and leave many others injured on Nigeria’s roads, with multiple-vehicle collisions recorded on major highways and inter-state routes.

Last month, six people were confirmed killed in a fatal motor accident that occurred along Girei Road in Adamawa State.

Months earlier, a multiple-vehicle accident on the Ibadan end of the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway claimed at least five lives, while eight people sustained varying degrees of injuries.

In April, the Ogun State Sector Command of the Federal Road Safety Corps (FRSC) confirmed three deaths in another multiple-vehicle crash at the Onipepeye axis of the Abeokuta–Sagamu Road in Obafemi Owode Local Government Area of the state. Seven other people were injured in the accident.

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/10/03/death-toll-from-plateau-road-crash-rises-to-21/

posts.title: ‘We Were Very Authentic,’ Stella Damasus Recalls Nollywood Memories
posts.excerpt: The veteran actress, whose career has spanned decades across stage and screen, said she and her contemporaries stood out because they remained true to themselves. The post ‘We Were Very Authentic,’ St
posts.content:
Nollywood veteran, author, coach, and singer Stella Damasus has identified authenticity as a defining quality that set her generation of leading female actors apart during the early era of Nollywood.

The veteran actress, whose career has spanned decades across stage and screen, said she and her contemporaries stood out because they remained true to themselves rather than trying to imitate others.

“We were very authentic,” Damasus said on the Pulse Old vs New show. “We were not trying to be like other people. We’re not trying to copy other people or be who we’re not. Everything was authentic.”

Damasus, who authored the book Mama It’s a Girl, further added that she, like other big actresses, Genevieve Nnaji and Omotola Jalade Ekehinde, in the early days of Nollywood, had no idea how far and how big they would later become from doing what they passionately enjoyed doing.

“I’m going to assure you, we were not doing it because of the fame or the money. There was no social media to tell us how big we could get. We did not know,” the veteran said.

“After you see yourself on a poster, that’s about it. People will recognise you here and there and all of that at that time. It wasn’t about the fame. It wasn’t about the money. How much were they paying us?”

“We just loved the job. It was more about passion.”

This screengrab shows Stella Damasus as a guest on Pulse Old vs New (Photo: YouTube/Pulse Nigeria)

The prominent screen actor recalled how tough and daring it was for any female to be seen as an actor.

“At that time, it wasn’t easy for females at that age to be allowed by parents and families to enter the industry,” she said. “So those of us who could were bold.”

Damasus admitted that the movie ‘The Widow’ from 2005, where she played the role of a grieving wife subjected to intense emotional and physical degradation by her husband’s relatives following his sudden death, was one of her most challenging roles, one of the biggest because it changed her career overnight, both at home and abroad.

“But I’m grateful for the role because I saw what could happen, and then it did happen,” she added.

Source: https://www.channelstv.com/2026/10/03/we-were-very-authentic-stella-damasus-recalls-nollywood-memories/

posts.title: Juventus want Leoni and Palmisani to rebuild Italian core in 2027
posts.excerpt: Saturday’s reports claim that Liverpool’s Giovanni Leooni and Frosinone goalkeeper Lorenzo Palmisani are among the...
posts.content:
Saturday’s reports claim that Liverpool’s Giovanni Leooni and Frosinone goalkeeper Lorenzo Palmisani are among the players wanted by Juventus to help rebuild their Italian core.

Gazzetta: Juventus eyeing three young Italian talents

For their two most recent matches before the international break, and for the first time ever in their Serie A history against Sassuolo on September 13, Juventus fielded a starting XI that featured no outfield Italian players. Goalkeeper Guglielmo Vicario is the only Italian to have started the last two games.

FROSINONE, ITALY – AUGUST 23: Guglielmo Vicario of FC Juventus gestures during the Serie A match between Frosinone Calcio and Juventus FC at Stadio Benito Stirpe on August 23, 2026 in Frosinone, Italy.(Photo by Giuseppe Bellini/Getty Images)This was largely due to injuries to captain Manuel Locatelli and Italy international Andrea Cambiaso, but if they had been available, Juventus are relatively short on Italian-born first-team players.

Their list of Italians based permanently with the first-team are goalkeepers Vicario and Carlo Pinsoglio, plus Cambiaso, Federico Gatti, Locatelli, Daniele Rugani and Jeff Ekhator. Of that list, Vicario, Cambiaso and Locatelli are the only ones expected to regularly start for the Bianconeri in Serie A.

For Bianconeri supporters, particularly those based in Italy, this is a cause for concern, given that the teams that won nine consecutive Serie A titles between 2012 and 2020 relied heavily on its block of Italy internationals, including the likes of Gianluigi Buffon, Leonardo Bonucci, Andrea Barzagli, Giorgio Chiellini and Andrea Pirlo.

According to La Gazzetta dello Sport, this is an issue that has been recognised by the senior Juventus management, who hope to strengthen their squad with a number of upcoming Italian talents in future transfer windows.

CREMONA, ITALY – OCTOBER 14: Goalkeeper Lorenzo Palmisani of Italy reacts during the UEFA Euro U21 Qualification match between Italy and Armenia at Stadio Giovanni Zini on October 14, 2025 in Cremona, Italy. (Photo by Marco M. Mantovani/Getty Images)Among them is Frosinone goalkeeper Palmisani. Juve still have an option to make Vicario’s transfer permanent at a cost of €8m at the end of the 2026-27 season, but the Frosinone goalkeeper, currently a star of the Italy U21 squad, is being tipped as a long-term option.

Juventus are also admirers of Liverpool youngster Leoni, and according to La Gazzetta dello Sport, they had even offered to take the teenager on loan as part of his recovery from a year-long knee injury.

LIVERPOOL, ENGLAND – SEPTEMBER 23: Giovanni Leoni of Liverpool receives medical treatment to an injury before being substituted off during the Carabao Cup Third Round match between Liverpool and Southampton at Anfield on September 23, 2025 in Liverpool, England. (Photo by Stu Forster/Getty Images)Juventus are also said to be keen on Riccardo Calafiori and recently-capped Italy international Michael Kayode, but are aware that they will almost certainly both be out of the club’s price range in the summer.

La Gazzetta dello Sport claims that Juventus are also interested in a potential deal for Fiorentina midfielder Cher Ndour.

Source: https://football-italia.net/juventus-want-leoni-palmisani-italian-core/

Donnarumma was voted as Italy’s man of the match in the post-match ratings following Friday’s 1-1 draw away against France after a series of top-class saves that kept the Azzurri alive while they were under pressure from Zinedine Zidane’s side.

posts.title: Milan eyeing move for Brighton midfielder Ayari to replace Modric
posts.excerpt: Reports in Italy claim that Milan are eyeing a future move for Brighton & Hove...
posts.content:
Reports in Italy claim that Milan are eyeing a future move for Brighton & Hove Albion midfielder Yasin Ayari to strengthen Ruben Amorim’s midfield, which could lose the veteran Luka Modric and several other options at the end of the 2026-27 season.

Report: Milan want Brighton’s Ayari, valued at €40m

Milan have a healthy level of competition in their current midfield department, which includes Modric, Adrien Rabiot, the resurgent Yunus Musah, Ruben Loftus-Cheek and Ardon Jashari, not forgetting youngster Christian Comotto.

This could change next summer, though, as 41-year-old Modric is into the final year of his contract and could call it a day on his playing career in the summer. Even if he continues playing, another contract extension at San Siro seems unlikely.

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Luka Modric of AC Milan in action during the warm up before the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)Reports from Calciomercato.com hint that Loftus-Cheek’s days with Milan could be coming to an end. Jashari, who has struggled to nail down a spot since joining the Rossoneri last summer, is not guaranteed to stay with Milan into the 2027-28 season at this stage.

This leaves Milan already looking at potential midfield reinforcements just a few games into the 2026-27 season, and reports from Tuttosport claim that Brighton’s Ayari is at the top of the Rossoneri wishlist.

Milan have reportedly been following Ayari since the early stages of 2025 when Geoffrey Moncada was still in his position as technical director.

BRIGHTON, ENGLAND – AUGUST 15: Yasin Ayari of Brighton and Hove Albion warms up before the pre-season friendly match between Brighton & Hove Albion and Bologna at Amex Stadium on August 15, 2026 in Brighton, England. (Photo by Steve Bardens/Getty Images)Ayari has become a crucial part of Fabian Hurzeler’s Brighton midfield in the early stages of 2026-27 and has already netted his first goal of the Premier League season in a 5-0 hammering of his former club Coventry City.

Ayari put in a particularly encouraging performance and scored twice in a pre-season friendly between Brighton and Roma in July, attended by Football Italia.

BRIGHTON, ENGLAND – AUGUST 08: Yasin Ayari of Brighton & Hove Albion scores the third goal during the pre-season friendly match between Brighton & Hove Albion and AS Roma at American Express Stadium on August 08, 2026 in Brighton, England. (Photo by Steve Bardens/Getty Images)Ayari himself is into the final year of his contract with Brighton, expiring on June 30, 2027, but the club has an option to automatically extend by a further 12 months.

This means that the Sweden international is still valued in the region of €40m according to the latest reports in Italy.

Source: https://football-italia.net/milan-eyeing-move-brighton-midfielder-ayari/

posts.title: Five outfield players from Mancini’s 34-man Italy squad still waiting for first chances
posts.excerpt: Italy are three games into their 2026-27 Nations League campaign, but five outfield players from...
posts.content:
Italy are three games into their 2026-27 Nations League campaign, but five outfield players from Roberto Mancini’s squad are still waiting for their first opportunities of the September-October international break.

Which players have not featured for Italy this international break?

The Mancini revolution is beginning to pick up momentum despite a disappointing start to his second spell as head coach of the Italy national team. The Azzurri were beaten 2-0 at home by Belgium at the start of the break, but have since bounced back with a 4-1 win away against Turkey and a 1-1 draw away against Zinedine Zidane’s France.

PARIS, FRANCE – OCTOBER 02: Michael Kayode of Italy crosses the ball whilst under pressure from Adrien Rabiot of France during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between France and Italy at Stade de France on October 02, 2026 in Paris, France. (Photo by Pauline Figuet/Getty Images)Mancini initially named a squad of 34 players for the September-October international break, which has since been reduced to 32 after Nicolo Zaniolo and Giacomo Raspadori withdrew through injury without being replaced. Federico Dimarco and Bryan Cristante also withdrew at the start of the camp, but were replaced by Matteo Ruggeri and Samuele Ricci respectively.

Of the 32 players currently available, 28 are outfielders, and of those 28 outfielders, only five are still waiting for their first opportunities this international break.

They are Roma defender Daniele Ghilardi, Monza loanee Eddy Kouadio, Como midfielder Ricci, Fiorentina midfielder Rolando Mandragora and Borussia Dortmund forward Samuele Inacio.

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Roberto Mancini, Head Coach of Italy, looks on before the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)

Players used: Gianluigi Donnarumma, Giovanni Di Lorenzo, Michael Kayode, Gianluca Mancini, Giorgio Scalvini, Diego Coppola, Alessandro Bastoni, Riccardo Calafiori, Matteo Ruggeri, Nicolo Barella, Davide Frattesi, Alessandro Romano, Sandro Tonali, Issa Doumbia, Nicolo Fagioli, Nicolo Cambiaghi, Mohamed Ali Zoma, Sebastiano Esposito, Giacomo Raspadori, Daniel Maldini, Antonio Vergara, Pio Esposito, Moise Kean, Gianluca Scamacca.

Players not used: Marco Carnesecchi, Guglielmo Vicario, Massimo Pessina, Daniele Ghilardi, Eddy Kouadio, Samuele Ricci, Rolando Mandragora, Samuele Inacio.

LONDON, ENGLAND – AUGUST 09: Samuele Inacio of Borussia Dortmund during the pre-season friendly match between Arsenal FC and Borussia Dortmund at Emirates Stadium on August 09, 2026 in London, England. (Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images)There has been concern from some sections of the Italy support regarding Inacio specifically. Despite the fact that he earned his first and only cap for the Azzurri under Silvio Baldini back in June, that appearance came in a friendly, which means that he is still technically able to represent his father’s nation of birth, Brazil, at senior international level.

The 18-year-old has been left out of the last three Italy matchday squads, but there is still a small chance that he gets a run-out when Italy take on Turkey in their final Nations League match of the international break on Monday.

Head coach Roberto Mancini was recently asked about his decision to omit Inacio from the last three matches.

“He’s a young player who still needs to develop,” said Mancini.

“He’s 18. It takes time. He has to start training with us and build experience. Even if he’s at Borussia Dortmund, he hasn’t played much. We know his quality; he’ll surely be an important player for the national team, but he’s very young, so we need to give him time and let him understand what he can do.”

Read more: Why Italy have left Inacio out of all three matchday squads in September-October 2026 international break

Source: https://football-italia.net/five-italy-outfielders-waiting-first-chance/

posts.title: Milan eyeing move for Brighton midfielder Ayari to replace Modric
posts.excerpt: Reports in Italy claim that Milan are eyeing a future move for Brighton & Hove...
posts.content:
Reports in Italy claim that Milan are eyeing a future move for Brighton & Hove Albion midfielder Yasin Ayari to strengthen Ruben Amorim’s midfield, which could lose the veteran Luka Modric and several other options at the end of the 2026-27 season.

Report: Milan want Brighton’s Ayari, valued at €40m

Milan have a healthy level of competition in their current midfield department, which includes Modric, Adrien Rabiot, the resurgent Yunus Musah, Ruben Loftus-Cheek and Ardon Jashari, not forgetting youngster Christian Comotto.

This could change next summer, though, as 41-year-old Modric is into the final year of his contract and could call it a day on his playing career in the summer. Even if he continues playing, another contract extension at San Siro seems unlikely.

ROME, ITALY – SEPTEMBER 12: Luka Modric of AC Milan in action during the warm up before the Serie A match between SS Lazio and AC Milan at Stadio Olimpico on September 12, 2026 in Rome, Italy. (Photo by Paolo Bruno/Getty Images)Reports from Calciomercato.com hint that Loftus-Cheek’s days with Milan could be coming to an end. Jashari, who has struggled to nail down a spot since joining the Rossoneri last summer, is not guaranteed to stay with Milan into the 2027-28 season at this stage.

This leaves Milan already looking at potential midfield reinforcements just a few games into the 2026-27 season, and reports from Tuttosport claim that Brighton’s Ayari is at the top of the Rossoneri wishlist.

Milan have reportedly been following Ayari since the early stages of 2025 when Geoffrey Moncada was still in his position as technical director.

BRIGHTON, ENGLAND – AUGUST 15: Yasin Ayari of Brighton and Hove Albion warms up before the pre-season friendly match between Brighton & Hove Albion and Bologna at Amex Stadium on August 15, 2026 in Brighton, England. (Photo by Steve Bardens/Getty Images)Ayari has become a crucial part of Fabian Hurzeler’s Brighton midfield in the early stages of 2026-27 and has already netted his first goal of the Premier League season in a 5-0 hammering of his former club Coventry City.

Ayari put in a particularly encouraging performance and scored twice in a pre-season friendly between Brighton and Roma in July, attended by Football Italia.

BRIGHTON, ENGLAND – AUGUST 08: Yasin Ayari of Brighton & Hove Albion scores the third goal during the pre-season friendly match between Brighton & Hove Albion and AS Roma at American Express Stadium on August 08, 2026 in Brighton, England. (Photo by Steve Bardens/Getty Images)Ayari himself is into the final year of his contract with Brighton, expiring on June 30, 2027, but the club has an option to automatically extend by a further 12 months.

This means that the Sweden international is still valued in the region of €40m according to the latest reports in Italy.

Source: https://football-italia.net/milan-eyeing-move-brighton-midfielder-ayari/

posts.title: Five outfield players from Mancini’s 34-man Italy squad still waiting for first chances
posts.excerpt: Italy are three games into their 2026-27 Nations League campaign, but five outfield players from...
posts.content:
Italy are three games into their 2026-27 Nations League campaign, but five outfield players from Roberto Mancini’s squad are still waiting for their first opportunities of the September-October international break.

Which players have not featured for Italy this international break?

The Mancini revolution is beginning to pick up momentum despite a disappointing start to his second spell as head coach of the Italy national team. The Azzurri were beaten 2-0 at home by Belgium at the start of the break, but have since bounced back with a 4-1 win away against Turkey and a 1-1 draw away against Zinedine Zidane’s France.

PARIS, FRANCE – OCTOBER 02: Michael Kayode of Italy crosses the ball whilst under pressure from Adrien Rabiot of France during the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between France and Italy at Stade de France on October 02, 2026 in Paris, France. (Photo by Pauline Figuet/Getty Images)Mancini initially named a squad of 34 players for the September-October international break, which has since been reduced to 32 after Nicolo Zaniolo and Giacomo Raspadori withdrew through injury without being replaced. Federico Dimarco and Bryan Cristante also withdrew at the start of the camp, but were replaced by Matteo Ruggeri and Samuele Ricci respectively.

Of the 32 players currently available, 28 are outfielders, and of those 28 outfielders, only five are still waiting for their first opportunities this international break.

They are Roma defender Daniele Ghilardi, Monza loanee Eddy Kouadio, Como midfielder Ricci, Fiorentina midfielder Rolando Mandragora and Borussia Dortmund forward Samuele Inacio.

BURSA, TURKEY – SEPTEMBER 28: Roberto Mancini, Head Coach of Italy, looks on before the UEFA Nations League 2026/27 group phase match between Türkiye and Italy at Atatürk Spor Kompleksi Matli Stadyumu on September 28, 2026 in Bursa, Turkey. (Photo by Ahmad Mora/Getty Images)

Players used: Gianluigi Donnarumma, Giovanni Di Lorenzo, Michael Kayode, Gianluca Mancini, Giorgio Scalvini, Diego Coppola, Alessandro Bastoni, Riccardo Calafiori, Matteo Ruggeri, Nicolo Barella, Davide Frattesi, Alessandro Romano, Sandro Tonali, Issa Doumbia, Nicolo Fagioli, Nicolo Cambiaghi, Mohamed Ali Zoma, Sebastiano Esposito, Giacomo Raspadori, Daniel Maldini, Antonio Vergara, Pio Esposito, Moise Kean, Gianluca Scamacca.

Players not used: Marco Carnesecchi, Guglielmo Vicario, Massimo Pessina, Daniele Ghilardi, Eddy Kouadio, Samuele Ricci, Rolando Mandragora, Samuele Inacio.

LONDON, ENGLAND – AUGUST 09: Samuele Inacio of Borussia Dortmund during the pre-season friendly match between Arsenal FC and Borussia Dortmund at Emirates Stadium on August 09, 2026 in London, England. (Photo by Justin Setterfield/Getty Images)There has been concern from some sections of the Italy support regarding Inacio specifically. Despite the fact that he earned his first and only cap for the Azzurri under Silvio Baldini back in June, that appearance came in a friendly, which means that he is still technically able to represent his father’s nation of birth, Brazil, at senior international level.

The 18-year-old has been left out of the last three Italy matchday squads, but there is still a small chance that he gets a run-out when Italy take on Turkey in their final Nations League match of the international break on Monday.

Head coach Roberto Mancini was recently asked about his decision to omit Inacio from the last three matches.

“He’s a young player who still needs to develop,” said Mancini.

“He’s 18. It takes time. He has to start training with us and build experience. Even if he’s at Borussia Dortmund, he hasn’t played much. We know his quality; he’ll surely be an important player for the national team, but he’s very young, so we need to give him time and let him understand what he can do.”

Read more: Why Italy have left Inacio out of all three matchday squads in September-October 2026 international break

Source: https://football-italia.net/five-italy-outfielders-waiting-first-chance/

posts.title: California K-9 Otis helps police seize 440 pounds of cocaine during Alhambra traffic stop
posts.excerpt: K-9 Otis sniffed out roughly 440 pounds of cocaine during a California traffic stop after the driver's shifting stories raised red flags to responding officers.
posts.content:
A California traffic stop took a massive turn when a police K-9 sniffed out approximately 200 kilos, or roughly 440 pounds, of cocaine allegedly packed inside an SUV filled with cardboard boxes, authorities said.

The Alhambra Police Department said the incident began after officers conducted a traffic stop along Valley Boulevard near the 710 Freeway.

Although authorities did not say what prompted the initial stop, they noticed the driver appeared to have an unusual amount of cargo in his vehicle.

"The driver was transporting more cardboard boxes than Amazon on Prime Day," police said in a social media post.

BORDER AGENTS UNCOVER $20M COCAINE STASH HIDDEN BENEATH TRUCK FLOORBOARDS IN MASSIVE BUST

That's when the driver began offering an explanation for the boxes, according to police.

"At first, he said he was heading home to Huntington Park from his cousin’s house and that the boxes were not his," police said in the post.

But that wasn't the man's only story.

"Later came version 2.0 of his lore," police continued, "and he said he was taking diesel parts to a shop that his friend owned."

Up stepped K-9 Otis and his handler to help investigate.

BORDER AGENTS UNCOVER $3.7M IN COCAINE MASQUERADING AS A CUCUMBER DELIVERY

Police said Otis alerted officers to the vehicle, prompting them to search the SUV.

"Thanks to Otis’ top-tier nose, he alerted to the vehicle, and officers discovered the SUV was packed with approximately 200 kilos of cocaine," police said.

The driver, identified as Julio Rangel of Huntington Park, was arrested and booked into the Alhambra Police Department jail, according to police.

Following the drug bust, Otis was hailed as the hero of the operation.

HEROIC FLORIDA K-9 RETURNS TO SHERIFF'S OFFICE DAYS AFTER BEING SHOT PROTECTING 3 DEPUTIES, LOSING LEG

"A round of a-paws for our good boy, K9 Otis," police said.

Users on social media also praised the K-9's work, with many arguing that Otis had earned a promotion — and was perhaps even on track to become police chief one day.

"Give that dog a bone!" another user exclaimed.

One user joked about Otis' ability to sniff out criminals.

"No One escapes from the Long Paw of …. The DOG"

Others suggested that, at the very least, Otis deserved a big steak dinner.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/us/california-k-9-otis-helps-police-seize-440-pounds-cocaine-alhambra-traffic-stop

posts.title: Brewers take Game 1 of NLDS after a controversial call on sure-fire home run ball that hit the stadium roof
posts.excerpt: William Contreras launched a go-ahead solo homer in the seventh inning as the Milwaukee Brewers edged the San Diego Padres 3-2 in NLDS Game 1.
posts.content:
The best-of-five NLDS between the Milwaukee Brewers and San Diego Padres is one of the most anticipated of the MLB postseason.

And boy, did Game 1 — a 3-2 Brewers win — not disappoint, even ending with one of the most bizarre, unlucky things you will ever see in a Major League Baseball game.

The Brewers were the best team in baseball this season, while the Padres went on a tear down the stretch to make the playoffs, and then made short work of the Chicago Cubs in the Wild Card Round.

CLICK HERE FOR MORE OUTKICK SPORTS COVERAGE

Presumptive NL Cy Young favorite Jacob Misiorowski took the hill for the Brewers in what was the first postseason start of the hard-throwing righty's career. Meanwhile, lefty Robbie Ray got the nod for San Diego.

Misiorowski set the tone early, striking out Padres star and lead-off hitter Fernando Tatis Jr., which helped keep the raucous crowd at American Family Field in a frenzy.

However, in the second inning, something seemed to click for the Padres when DH Luis Campusano poked a single into right field with two on, which brought in a run to open the scoring.

The Padres added another on a fielder's choice to go up 2-0.

In the third, the Brewers got on the board thanks to a Jackson Chourio two-run shot, which happened to be the hardest-hit homer of his career.

The game remained tied through six innings, with Misiorowski exiting the game after four innings of work in which he gave up 6 hits, 2 runs, and a walk while striking out 6 hitters.

THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW!

In the seventh inning, Milwaukee brought in relief pitcher Abner Uribe to face Tatis and Manny Machado; however, both managed to get on base. Then with the two on first and third respectively, Uribe hit first baseman Ty France to load the bases.

Uribe got the hook, with lefty DL Hall coming in to face left-handed-hitting Padres center fielder Jackson Merrill.

Fortunately for the Brewers, Merrill flew out to left field, getting them out of a big jam.

That was key, because after retiring two batters on two pitches to start the bottom of the seventh, Brewers catcher William Contreras took the 3-2 offering from Adrian Morejon and sent it into the seats in right-center field.

That solo home run was just Contreras' second hit all season against San Diego pitching.

The Brewers got out of another jam in the top of the eighth with the Padres leaving several runners on base, something that was a theme for both teams throughout the night.

The top of the 9th brought the strangest moment of the game when Ty France nearly hit the cover of the ball for what looked like a go-ahead, two-run home run.

However, the ball hit one of the trusses in the stadium's roof. The ball then bounced nearly straight down and was caught by Jackson Chourio.

The rule is that if the ball hits the roof in fair territory, it's still live. Chourio made a clutch play to track it down and keep the tying run from scoring.

The Padres challenged, but the call stood for the second out of the inning.

Jackson Merrill was the next batter and lined out to right field to end the game.

It was a good game from start to finish, but with so many strong performances on display, who would have thought the Brewers' biggest play would come from the roof at American Family Field?

Game 2 is Sunday afternoon in Milwaukee, and you can catch it on FS1.

If it's even half as entertaining as Game 1, it'll be must-see TV.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/outkick-sports/brewers-take-game-1-nlds-controversial-call-sure-fire-home-run-ball-hit-stadium-roof

posts.title: Shooting near Baltimore youth football event leaves 12-year-old girl dead, 3 adults wounded
posts.excerpt: A parking dispute near a youth football event at Leon Day Park in Baltimore turned deadly when two men allegedly opened fire on each other, killing a 12-year-old girl in the crossfire.
posts.content:
A 12-year-old girl was killed and three adults were wounded after two gunmen allegedly opened fire during a dispute near a youth football game in Baltimore, Maryland, authorities said Saturday.

The preteen girl was apparently caught in the crossfire at Leon Day Park, where a youth football league was holding its homecoming event, Baltimore Police Commissioner Richard Worley said during a news conference.

The two men are believed to have been in a dispute that started over a parking space, according to Worley.

"What we know is that there was some type of argument between two cowards, and of course, they both opened fire on each other," Worley said.

PANTHERS GREAT JONATHAN STEWART EXPLAINS WHY YOUTH SPORTS MATTER FAR BEYOND THE FIELD

"In the crossfire, a 12-year-old little girl who was probably down there watching football was shot and killed," he added.

As of Saturday evening, police said they were searching for at least two suspects, whom authorities described as adult men. No arrests had been announced as of late Saturday night.

Baltimore police told Fox News Digital that officers responded to the 1200 block of North Franklintown Road at approximately 6:15 p.m. after receiving multiple reports of gunfire.

Officers found a 25-year-old woman suffering from an apparent gunshot wound and the 12-year-old girl, who was transported to a hospital but later pronounced dead.

LEXINGTON, KENTUCKY PARK SHOOTING KILLS 1, INJURES 4 DURING LIVE BAND PERFORMANCE

A 28-year-old man and a 23-year-old man separately walked into area hospitals seeking treatment for gunshot wounds, police said.

All three surviving victims were listed in stable condition.

Baltimore Mayor Brandon Scott gave an emotionally charged reaction to the incident, which he said unfolded because two adults couldn't resolve an argument without guns.

"Two grown men got into an argument and now a 12-year-old is gone," he said.

AT LEAST 3 DEAD, 23 WOUNDED IN SEPARATE MASS SHOOTINGS LESS THAN 15 MINUTES APART

"What happened out here today is one of the most disgusting things I've ever seen in my life," Scott added.

Scott said the girl's death would have a profound impact on the community before offering his condolences to her family.

"We're never gonna see her full potential," he said. "Her family's gonna be hurting for this for the rest of their life. Her classmates are going to be hurting, her community's going to be hurting."

Anyone with information is asked to call homicide detectives at 410-396-2100 or Metro Crime Stoppers at 1-866-7LOCKUP. Anonymous tips can also be submitted through Metro Crime Stoppers of Maryland.

Source: https://www.foxnews.com/us/shooting-near-baltimore-youth-football-event-leaves-12-year-old-girl-dead-3-adults-wounded

posts.title: Texas mother facing capital murder charges after allegedly shooting her two sons to death
posts.excerpt: Colleen Nichole Lemmon allegedly told officers she shot both her sons at their Waxahachie home before deputies found her with self-inflicted injuries.
posts.content:
A Texas mother is facing capital murder charges after allegedly shooting her two sons before appearing to harm herself, authorities said.

Colleen Nichole Lemmon, 42, was taken into custody and charged with two counts of capital murder, according to the Ellis County Sheriff's Office.

Authorities said they received a call about an "unknown emergency" just before 4:15 a.m. Thursday on Big Sky Drive in Waxahachie.

Upon arriving at the scene, deputies discovered two male victims with gunshot wounds inside the residence.

ILLINOIS MOTHER CHARGED WITH MURDER IN DEATH OF 2-YEAR-OLD SON IN CASE DRAWING COMPARISONS TO LINDSAY CLANCY

Christopher Scott Pitre, 21, was pronounced dead at the scene. The second victim, a 15-year-old boy, was taken to a hospital in critical condition, where he later died.

Deputies said they also found Lemmon suffering from non-life-threatening injuries.

Evidence recovered during the investigation gave law enforcement probable cause to believe Lemmon was responsible for shooting both of her children.

DAYS AFTER LINDSAY CLANCY MISTRIAL, ANOTHER MASSACHUSETTS MOM ACCUSED OF KILLING HER CHILDREN SEEKS FREEDOM

Deputies found Lemmon covered in blood with what appeared to be self-inflicted lacerations on her wrists and a handgun nearby, according to an arrest affidavit obtained by FOX 4.

Lemmon allegedly told officers, "I shot both my kids."

She was arrested and transported to a local hospital for treatment, authorities said.

Scott Pitre, the boys' father, told NBC 5 that his younger son had recently celebrated his 15th birthday. He said he wants justice for his sons.

LINDSAY CLANCY'S THREE CHILD VICTIMS FORGOTTEN AMID CROWDS OF SUPPORT: MOTHER OF SIX

Ida Brown, a neighbor, described the killings as "heartbreaking."

"It's heartbreaking, and I'm praying for them," she told FOX 4.

Sheriff Brad Norman offered his condolences to the family.

"My deepest sympathies go out to the victims' father, family members, and loved ones involved in this tragic incident," Norman said in a statement. "They will remain in our prayers during this difficult time."

Lemmon is being held on a $2.5 million bond.
